item.title: Singapore MPA builds capability to supply various bunker fuels
item.description: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said on Wednesday it is expanding the world's largest bunkering port's ability to supply a wider range of fuels as shipping firms diversify fuel sources and pursue decarbonisation goals.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said on Wednesday it is expanding the world's largest bunkering port's ability to supply a wider range of fuels as shipping firms diversify fuel sources and pursue decarbonisation goals. MPA will invite bids from companies by end-2026 for licences to operate liquefied natural gas Floating Storage Units (FSUs) in Singapore anchorages, expanding storage capacity to meet rising LNG bunkering demand. MPA, CMA CGM and Singapore LNG Corp signed a memorandum of understanding to explore the use of liquefied bio-methane as a marine fuel. Singapore will conduct its first ethanol bunkering operation at PSA’s Pasir Panjang Terminal later this week, involving Maersk, Golden Island Pte Ltd and PSA Singapore. To support ammonia bunkering, MPA and Enterprise Singapore have launched a technical reference setting out safety requirements, bunkering procedures, custody transfer standards and competency requirements for personnel. The Singapore Chamber of Maritime Arbitration (SCMA) is also developing a model contract for ammonia bunkering transactions. MPA will accelerate the use of electric harbour craft by introducing a two-year grant for early adopters from January 1, 2027.

item.title: ＣＮＮなどにホワイトハウス取材許可を延長、米地裁
item.description:
Jack Queen Jan Wolfe
[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 米首都ワシントンの連邦地裁は１３日、米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）、ポリティコの記者によるホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを認める命令を延長した。トランプ大統領が３社の記者をホワイトハウスでの取材から排除したのは違法である可能性が高いと判断した。報道の自由を巡る訴訟でトランプ氏に不利な判断が再び示された。
ティモシー・ケリー連邦地裁判事は、記者らの取材を認めるよう命じた９月２４日の措置について詳述する文書を公表した。
報道各社や報道の自由を擁護する団体は、トランプ氏が気に入らない報道をした記者に対し、憲法に反する報復措置を取っていると非難している。
９月の命令は、ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jack Queen　Jan Wolfe

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 米首都ワシントンの連邦地裁は１３日、米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ（旧ＭＳＮＢＣ）、ポリティコの記者によるホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを認める命令を延長した。トランプ大統領が３社の記者をホワイトハウスでの取材から排除したのは違法である可能性が高いと判断した。報道の自由を巡る訴訟でトランプ氏に不利な判断が再び示された。

ティモシー・ケリー連邦地裁判事は、記者らの取材を認めるよう命じた９月２４日の措置について詳述する文書を公表した。

報道各社や報道の自由を擁護する団体は、トランプ氏が気に入らない報道をした記者に対し、憲法に反する報復措置を取っていると非難している。

９月の命令は、ＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ、ポリティコの記者によるホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを一時的に認めるものだった。１３日に出した仮差し止め命令は、控訴裁判所（高裁）が解除しない限り、報道各社が起こした訴訟で判事が最終判断を下すまで効力を持つ。

ケリー判事は判断の中で、トランプ氏が各社の報道に偏りがあり不正確だと考えて立ち入りを禁じたのは同氏の公の発言から明らかだと指摘。政府側の弁護士が後に法廷で主張したような、国家安全保障上の懸念が理由ではなかったとした。

「端的に言えば、これは見解を理由とした違法な差別だ」と記した。一方で「この判断がトランプ氏の不満には根拠がないと示していると受け取るべきではない」と述べた。

ケリー氏はトランプ氏が１期目の２０１７年に任命した。

item.title: US Justice Department threatens California over alleged noncitizen voters, letter shows
item.description: The US Justice Department on Tuesday gave California officials 48 hours to review a list of alleged noncitizen voters or face legal action, according to a letter reviewed by Reuters - part of an unprecedented effort to find evidence of voter fraud ahead of next month's elections.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage , Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department on Tuesday gave California officials 48 hours to review a list of alleged noncitizen voters or face legal action, according to a letter reviewed by Reuters - part of an unprecedented effort to find evidence of voter fraud ahead of next month's elections. The letter, written by acting Deputy Attorney General R. Trent McCotter and addressed to California Secretary of State Shirley Weber, says the Justice Department provided officials in Los Angeles County with a "password-protected thumb drive" with the names of people the federal government "believes are likely noncitizens" and were sent mail-in ballots. The letter demands that the state refuse to send ballots to those on the list until their citizenship status has been confirmed. Voters in question who have already received ballots should have their ballot "segregated" once it is mailed back; ballots already returned should not be tabulated "until citizenship has been determined," the letter stipulates. The federal government "will have no choice but to seek emergency relief," according to the letter, if state officials do not follow its instructions. "Allowing noncitizens to vote cancels citizen votes," McCotter wrote. The letter marks an escalation of the Trump administration's attempts to pressure states over alleged voting by non-US citizens and signals the Justice Department may be prepared to challenge ballots in the weeks leading up to the November 3 election, when Republicans will be defending their narrow majorities in Congress. Justice Department spokeswoman Kiersten Pels confirmed the existence of the letter in a statement to Reuters, adding: "The department will take all necessary legal action to protect election integrity and ensure compliance with federal law.” Representatives from the White House and the California secretary of state's office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. FRAUD CLAIMS The Justice Department under President Donald Trump has repeatedly claimed that voting by non-US citizens is widespread, despite multiple studies showing it is rare. Though states may have added more than [USN:L6N43Z058 TEXT:"30,000 noncitizens to their voter rolls"] since 2000 due to software glitches and clerical errors, Reuters found in September, it was unclear how many had cast a ballot. Experts said the numbers were too small relative to the country’s 170 million registered voters to affect elections. In July, the Justice Department [USN:L6N43A182 TEXT:"sent letters"] to chief election officials in all 50 states warning they could face criminal prosecution if they knowingly allowed noncitizens to remain on their voter rolls or cast ballots. The department's Civil Rights Division has demanded nonpublic voter data, including voters' Social Security numbers or dates of birth, from nearly all states as part of its hunt for noncitizens on state rolls. It has [USN:L6N44118V TEXT:"sued"] 30 Democratic- and Republican-led states that refused to hand over their rolls, but has [USN:S0N3R907R TEXT:"lost 26 of those cases"] without winning one. Reuters [USN:L6N45D0T4 TEXT:"reported"] last month that the Department of Homeland Security was using a commercial data broker to find sensitive voter information not included in publicly available rolls, which officials and experts warned could lead to citizens being falsely flagged as illegal voters and potentially detained. Federal prosecutors have also [USN:L6N45F10R TEXT:"ramped up"] prosecutions of noncitizens for allegedly voting in past elections or submitting fraudulent registrations, touting 16 new criminal cases on Monday. Officials in Democratic-led California have tussled for months with the Trump administration over its attempts to intervene in election procedures over allegations of voter fraud. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin informed California officials on July 16 that the federal government believed the state had noncitizens on its voting rolls, according to the letter. California could prove pivotal in deciding control of the US House of Representatives, especially after the state's voters approved a new congressional map that heavily favors Democrats as part of a nationwide redistricting sprint that began in Republican-led states. Voters in Los Angeles will also weigh in on a ballot measure that would allow certain noncitizen legal residents to cast ballots in municipal elections.

item.title: Golden Knights stay hot, pull away from Predators
item.description: William Karlsson scored the tiebreaking goal late in the second period Tuesday night to spark a three-goal surge for the Vegas Golden Knights, who beat the host Nashville Predators 5-2.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: William Karlsson scored the tiebreaking goal late in the second period Tuesday night to spark a three-goal surge for the Vegas Golden Knights, who beat the host Nashville Predators 5-2. Tomas Hertl and Jack Eichel scored in the first period, while Trevor Connelly and Brett Howden added insurance in the third for the Golden Knights, who have won five of their last six and lead the Western Conference with 12 points. Goalie Adin Hill made 25 saves, including a Jack Drury penalty shot with 6:51 left in the first to maintain Vegas' 2-1 lead. Ryan O'Reilly had a goal and an assist and Adam Edstrom also scored for the Predators, who have dropped four of their first six. Goalie Juuse Saros recorded 20 saves. O'Reilly opened the scoring 3:55 into the first, when he picked off a pass by Shea Theodore and dished to Filip Forsberg before swooping in and backhanding home the rebound. A Predators turnover led to Hertl's goal a little under three minutes later. Howden intercepted a pass by Ross Colton to begin the sequence that ended with Hertl firing a shot over Saros' glove shoulder at the 6:46 mark. An impressive effort by Eichel gave the Golden Knights their first lead with 7:12 left in the first. Brayden McNabb passed into the crease, where Eichel extended his right arm and flicked the puck past Saros. Edstrom tied the game with a short-handed goal 8:45 into the second, when he retrieved the rebound from his breakaway attempt and poked a shot around Hill and into the far corner of the net. Karlsson put the Golden Knights ahead for good nine minutes later, when he took a feed from Mitch Marner and beat Saros over his stick shoulder from the right faceoff circle. Vegas doubled the lead 4:49 into the third. Noah Hanifin passed from the goal line to Connelly, whose shot went over Saros' glove. Howden added insurance 1:35 later. --Field Level Media

item.title: Singapore marine fuel supplier Equatorial eyes higher LNG bunker demand from 2028
item.description: Equatorial Marine Fuel Management, a top Singapore bunker supplier by volume, plans to channel part of its 2026 profits to fund its expansion into supplying liquefied natural gas to ships as it positions for higher demand from 2028, its executives said.
item.dc:creator: Jeslyn Lerh
item.content:encoded: Equatorial Marine Fuel Management, a top Singapore bunker supplier by volume, plans to channel part of its 2026 profits to fund its expansion into supplying liquefied natural gas to ships as it positions for higher demand from 2028, its executives said. The company, which was one of eight suppliers [USN:L1N43W0ED TEXT:"awarded"] an LNG bunker licence in late July, is in discussions with LNG cargo suppliers and shipowners for collaborations, its executive director Choong Zhen Mao told Reuters on the sidelines of the Singapore International Bunkering conference. "The opportunity that we see in LNG still seems to be growing, even in this climate. I think that's where we see the market moving," he said, referring to the surge in LNG prices after the US-Israeli war on Iran disrupted exports from the Middle East. The company will be receiving its first new-built LNG bunker barge in the later part of the third quarter in 2027, he added. Equatorial's chief operating officer, Choong Sheen Mao, expects a more notable increase in Singapore's LNG bunker demand from 2028 as more LNG production capacity and dual-fuel vessels come online globally. Equatorial currently supplies about 10% of total bunker volumes at Singapore, the world's biggest refuelling hub for ships, according to its executives. The city state has supplied an average 4.7 million tons of bunker fuel a month so far in 2026, official data show. The company's year-to-date profits for 2026 have exceeded last year's level, the executives said, though they did not disclose the figures. Bunker fuel prices surged after US and Israeli strikes on Iran in late February drove oil prices higher, and have remained volatile since then. The ensuing disruption to shipping routes supported refuelling demand in key hubs including Singapore. "Demand looks to be resilient," said ED Choong. "When there is uncertainty, sometimes people tend to purchase a bit more, fill their tanks a bit more... people tend to break a voyage down into smaller trades these days to ensure availability and cargo security." Equatorial owns eight fuel oil barges, seven marine gasoil barges, as well as four chemical bunker tankers that meet International Maritime Organization's type 2 standard to carry methanol or biofuel blends up to 100% biofuel content. Some of the chemical bunker barges have been repurposed to supply conventional fuel this year amid a slowdown in marine biofuel demand, COO Choong said. "Demand for biofuels has slowed this year because of the delay in the IMO's net-zero framework, while current prices are not competitive," he said. Depending on the blend and delivery window, biofuel blends command premiums of at least $100 per metric ton over conventional low-sulphur bunker fuel oil, according to industry sources.

item.title: Liverpool boss Iraola has 100% trust in Wirtz and Barcola
item.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola has no doubts that big-money signings Florian Wirtz and Bradley Barcola will deliver for the club and says their contributions to the side are being overlooked due to the constant focus on their transfer fees.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola has no doubts that big-money signings Florian Wirtz and Bradley Barcola will deliver for the club and says their contributions to the side are being overlooked due to the constant focus on their transfer fees. Liverpool spent over £200 million ($265 million) to acquire the pair but both have come in for criticism. Wirtz had an underwhelming 2025-26 campaign and has just one assist this season, while [USN:L6N44S0QI TEXT:"Barcola"], who arrived in August, has yet to produce a goal or an assist. "With Bradley and Flo, they have had good games and bad games this season like everyone else," Iraola told reporters on Tuesday ahead of their Champions League meeting with LASK. "We know their level and we know they will give us good performances. "The other day, if Lewis Koumas scores the goal that he connects with really well (in their [USN:L1N45X053 TEXT:"3-0 loss to Manchester City"]), then it is one assist for Bradley Barcola. "His performance would be exactly the same but we will all say: 'Oh, he played really well with an assist.' Sometimes we focus only on the numbers. "With Bradley, the other day he had good situations and we did not finish them. Bradley and Flo are players that I trust 100%." Liverpool face LASK in Linz later on Wednesday, before travelling to Brentford in the Premier League on Saturday. ($1 = 0.7539 pounds)

item.title: Martin Necas, Avalanche surge ahead, hold off Stars
item.description: Martin Necas had two goals, Mackenzie Blackwood bounced back from a difficult outing to make 24 saves, and the visiting Colorado Avalanche beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 in the first game of a home-and-home set Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Martin Necas had two goals, Mackenzie Blackwood bounced back from a difficult outing to make 24 saves, and the visiting Colorado Avalanche beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 in the first game of a home-and-home set Tuesday night. Artturi Lehkonen also scored and Nathan MacKinnon had two assists and also fought for the second time in the first six games for Colorado. The teams play again Wednesday night in Denver. The Avalanche were without All-Star defenseman Cale Makar and forward Zachary L'Heureux. Makar stayed in Colorado to be with his wife, who was expecting twins, while L'Heureux was a late scratch due to an upper-body injury. Dallas played without center Wyatt Johnston, who was also a late scratch with an illness. Johnston had played the full 82-game regular-season schedule each of his first four NHL seasons as well as the Stars' first five games this season. The Stars' Tyler Seguin had a goal and an assist and Roope Hintz also scored to go along with his fight with MacKinnon in the second period. The scuffle opened a cut on the bridge of MacKinnon's nose, and he went to the locker room for nearly eight minutes before returning. Miro Heiskanen had two assists and Jake Oettinger turned away 22 shots for Dallas. The Avalanche took the lead midway through the first period when Josh Manson's shot from the point hit MacKinnon's skate, back to Lehkonen, who knocked it past Oettinger at 11:32. Seguin tied it on the power play in the final minute of the first with his second goal in as many games. Colorado answered in the second period. Necas gave the Avalanche the lead when he took a backhand pass from MacKinnon and beat Oettinger with a one-timer at 3:05. Necas made it 3-1 when he scored on a 5-on-3 at 16:14. Blackwood, who allowed five goals on 22 shots in a 6-3 home loss to Toronto on Saturday, kept it a two-goal advantage heading into the second intermission when he stoned Sam Steel on a point-blank shot after a turnover by Colorado defenseman Sam Malinski. Hintz got the Stars within a goal when he scored 3:17 into the third. Oettinger came off for an extra skater with 1:49 left but Dallas couldn't score. --Field Level Media

item.title: Austal shares jump as Hanwha gets more time to bid for US unit
item.description: Australian shipbuilder Austal said on Wednesday it had extended the due diligence period for Hanwha Group, allowing the South Korean conglomerate more time to formulate a formal offer for its US business, sending its shares sharply higher.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australian shipbuilder Austal (ASB.AX) said on Wednesday it had extended the due diligence period for Hanwha Group, allowing the South Korean conglomerate more time to formulate a formal offer for its US business, sending its shares sharply higher. Here are some details: Austal said commercial negotiations with Hanwha had started on the terms of a potential transaction, while the company also continues to assess its tax implications. Austal shares jumped as much as 11.5% to A$4.18 by 0315 GMT, posting their strongest intraday gain since August 11. "Regarding due diligence, while the substantive issues in the data room have been closed out, and the original parameters of the transaction have not changed, a tail of lower materiality data requests remains outstanding," Austal said in a statement. The company said it also remains in discussions with US-based Wildcat Infrastructure regarding its proposal to acquire Austal's US operations. Wildcat Infrastructure [USN:L4N45101Q TEXT:"in September"] offered up to $1.35 billion for Austal's US business, topping an earlier bid of up to $1.20 billion from Hanwha.

item.title: Report: Alex DeBrincat, Red Wings finalizing 7-year contract extension
item.description: Forward Alex DeBrincat and the Detroit Red Wings are finalizing a seven-year contract extension valued at $13 million annually, ESPN reported on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Forward Alex DeBrincat and the Detroit Red Wings are finalizing a seven-year contract extension valued at $13 million annually, ESPN reported on Tuesday night. DeBrincat leads the Red Wings with eight points, four goals, four assists and a plus-7 rating in six games after he scored twice and added an assist in their 5-4 overtime loss at home to the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday. The 28-year-old was eligible for a contract extension this summer, before the new collective bargaining agreement started in September. The former maximum for a contract was eight years; now it is seven. For his career, DeBrincat has 603 points (298 goals, 305 assists), 198 penalty minutes, 281 blocks and 557 hits in 702 regular-season games for the Chicago Blackhawks (2017-22), Ottawa Senators (2022-23) and Red Wings (2023-present). An All-Star in 2022 and 2024, he also has six points (two goals, four assists), nine penalty minutes, three blocks and 13 hits in nine playoff games with Chicago in the 2019-20 season. Chicago selected DeBrincat in the second round of the 2016 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: IMF's Georgieva optimistic on Senegal debt treatment under improved G20 framework
item.description: International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said on Wednesday that she was optimistic that Senegal would be able to renegotiate its debts, and that would demonstrate that improvements to the G20 debt treatment framework are working.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said on Wednesday that she was optimistic that Senegal would be able to renegotiate its debts, and that would demonstrate that improvements to the G20 debt treatment framework are working. She told a briefing at IMF and World Bank annual meetings that the IMF would support Senegal with a staff-negotiated agreement for a $2.2 billion program, but the debt treatment was being worked out between Senegal and its creditors. "I can tell you that my conversations with key creditors indicate everybody understands this is the test case to the playbook we have adopted through the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable," she said. "It is very important that we demonstrate that yes, indeed, the G20 common framework is improved, enhanced, and it can deliver results quickly. Senegal deserves it."

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ア・リーグ優勝決定Ｓ、ペラルタ好投のレイズが勝利し1勝1敗に
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１３日、ア・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）第２戦を行い、レイズがガーディアンズに３─１で勝利し、１勝１敗のタイとした。

レイズは先発のフレディ・ペラルタ投手が６回を４安打無失点、３四死球、６奪三振と好投。五回には９９．４マイル（約１６０キロ）の速球を放っており、ＭＬＢ公式サイトによるとこれが同投手のキャリア最速で、さらに９７マイル超えを２９球披露した。

チームは四回、二死一、三塁で打席に立ったベン・ウィリアムソン二塁手の三ゴロをホセ・ラミレス三塁手が失策し、先制に成功。続くリアム・ヒックス捕手が２点適時打を放って３─０とした。

第１戦で７─３の勝利を収めていたガーディアンズは、この日は七回の１得点にとどまった。

item.title: India's 'cockroach' movement leaders detained in jail for five days, party says
item.description: The detentions risk triggering fresh protests by youth supporters at a time when opposition groups and student bodies are holding almost daily demonstrations to demand election chief Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter list revisions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Indian court ordered that two leaders of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) be detained in jail for five days, the party said on Wednesday, a day after they scaled barricades to enter a historic site popular for protests and chanted slogans demanding the election chief's resignation. The detentions risk triggering fresh protests by youth supporters at a time when opposition groups and student bodies are holding almost daily demonstrations to demand commissioner [USN:P8N44T0DC TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar's"] resignation over [USN:L1N45V037 TEXT:"voter list revisions"] that critics say favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). The Election Commission has denied favouring any party and said wrongly deleted voters can re-enrol, while the BJP has accused rivals of trying to undermine democracy by wrongly questioning legitimate electoral processes. CJP leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were among about a dozen people who [USN:L6N45Z0LD TEXT:"jumped barricades "]on Tuesday to enter the grounds of the Jantar Mantar open air observatory in Delhi's central business district. Police said this week that the site -- previously designated for demonstrations -- was no longer an official protest venue. Das and Ranka were sent to prison on grounds including violation of a bond which had secured their release from an earlier detention on the weekend, their lawyer Abhisht Hela told reporters. "Delhi Police said they had violated their bond, and that they could do this again...that what they have done is a violation of law," he said. WILL NOT BE FRIGHTENED, CJP SAYS CJP leader Ajinkya Shinde, who was released on a personal bond, said the party would not be "frightened" by its leaders' imprisonment. "We will put an end to this dictatorial government," he said. Delhi Police did not respond to a request for comment. The 'cockroach' movement has mobilised protests in recent months against issues ranging from government school infrastructure to jobs and is among Modi and his BJP's biggest political challenges in his 12 years in power. A [USN:L1N43R02E TEXT:"weeks-long sit-in "]by its supporters at Jantar Mantar earlier this year forced Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over exam paper leaks. The recent demonstrations erupted after the Indian Express newspaper reported that Kumar's two deputies raised several concerns internally about the changes, registration procedures and digital systems. The revisions, which started last year, removed over 130 million names – more than the population of Japan – from voter lists, including 28 million who died, 63 million who relocated, and 30 million who could not be traced. Opposition parties allege the deletions disproportionately affect Muslims and other minorities, who are unlikely to support the Hindu nationalist ruling party — allegations the poll panel and BJP reject.

item.title: ＩＭＦ、財政再建へ早急な対応要請 国債利回り上昇受け
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１４日、先進国などに対し、政府...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＭＦ、財政再建へ早急な対応要請　国債利回り上昇受け 12:27 配信

ロドリゴ・バルデス財政局長。米ワシントンで4月撮影。 REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Andrea Shalal

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１４日、先進国などに対し、政府支出と財政赤字、債務残高の削減に向けて早急に行動するよう求めた。対応を先送りすれば、財政再建が一段と難しくなると警告した。

ロドリゴ・バルデス財政局長は、公的債務の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比が平均で１００％と、第２次世界大戦以降で最高の水準に達する見通しとなる中、国債利回りの上昇が財政への圧力を強め、各国が対応を先送りする余地を狭めているとの見方を示した。

バルデス氏は「現在が緊急であり、今こそ行動すべきだとわれわれが言うのは、基本的に状況が変化したからだ」と述べ、インフレ圧力や世界的な債務の高水準、国債利回りの上昇がもたらすリスクを挙げた。「一つのメッセージを挙げるとすれば、われわれは緊急性のトーンを引き上げたということだ」と語った。

バルデス氏は今週バンコクで開かれるＩＭＦ・世界銀行の会合を前にロイターのインタビューに応じ、「今年の財政状況は半年前の予想より悪く、１年前よりも悪い」と指摘。大半の国が現在、財政を引き締めるのではなく、支出の拡大を検討していると述べた。

＜政治的な支持固めが必要＞

その上で、債務水準の高い主要先進国は、借り入れコストを中期的に抑制し、他国への波及を限定するための具体的な計画について、政治的な支持を固める必要があるとした。

ＩＭＦは１４日公表したブログで「各国が対応を先送りすればするほど、調整の痛みは大きくなる」と指摘。調整が遅れれば利払い負担が増し、財政の脆弱性が高まり、政策の選択肢が一段と狭まると分析した。

多くの新興市場国や発展途上国の資金調達環境はこれまで良好に推移してきたものの、それが長続きしない可能性もあるとし、これらの国々に対しても財政の脆弱性を軽減し、債務管理を強化するよう促した。

対外的な資金調達が既に厳しい状況にある低所得国については、税制の強化と支出効率の改善が必要だと指摘した。

原油価格の高騰、根強いインフレ、投資需要の拡大、人工知能（ＡＩ）による想定を上回る成長などを背景に、ここ数カ月で長期国債利回りが大幅に上昇している。主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の１０年物国債利回りは平均で、２月から９月までに１１０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）超上昇し、約２０年ぶりの高水準に達した。

ＩＭＦによると、政府の実効的な平均資金調達コストは、２０２１年の２．３％から２０３１年には３．７％に上昇すると見込まれる。米国では利払い費の対ＧＤＰ比がコロナ禍前の２．８％から５．３％に達する見通しで、社会保障向け支出見込み額とほぼ同水準となる。

低所得国での比率はさらに高く、現在の利払い費は税収の１５％超を占めており、２０１１─１９年の平均約９％から大きく上昇している。

さらに、先進国の政府はより短い満期で借り換えを進めており、金利上昇が政府の資金調達コストに波及するスピードが速まっているという。Ｇ７とスペインでは、１年以内に満期を迎える債務の比率が現在、３０％に迫っている。

インフレ率が目標を上回り、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、中央銀行は金利を長期間にわたり高水準に維持する必要に迫られる可能性がある。これにより景気後退時の政府の対応能力が制約される一方、国防、エネルギー安全保障、高齢化への対応に伴う支出拡大圧力は強まっている。

債務金利が予想名目成長率を上回る国も複数出てきており、これらの国にとって債務の安定化は一段と難しくなるとＩＭＦは指摘した。

バルデス氏によると、エネルギー価格の上昇を国内価格に転嫁する動きを容認する国が増えているが、依然として多くの国がコストのかかる広範な措置によって国民を保護しようとしている。

バルデス氏は「これら全ての措置にかかる財政コストは、合計で世界のＧＤＰの約０．５％に相当するというのがわれわれの推計だ」と述べ、こうした措置の継続は世界的な物価上昇を助長すると指摘した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え 焦点：ジャクソンホール、切望されるウォーシュＦＲＢ議長の明確な政策説明 アングル：米国債、投資家はより高いリターンを要求 コラム：米長期金利上昇、相反するトランプ氏とベセント氏の思惑 コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/14(水) 14:02 ロイター

item.title: Taiwan must 'bear the consequences' of water cannon incident, China says
item.description: Taiwan must "bear the consequences" of its Coast Guard using a water cannon against a Chinese fishing boat near an atoll in the South China Sea, a Chinese government spokesperson said on Wednesday, as Taipei reported a rise in military activities.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Taiwan must "bear the consequences" of its Coast Guard using a water cannon against a Chinese fishing boat near an atoll in the South China Sea, a Chinese government spokesperson said on Wednesday, as Taipei reported a rise in military activities. A Taiwan Coast Guard ship this month fired its water cannon, saying the boat failed to respond to warnings to move away from restricted waters close to the Taiwan-controlled Pratas Islands. The boat then suffered engine failure and was towed away by a nearby Chinese vessel, Taiwan's Coast Guard said. Chen Binhua, a spokesperson for China's Taiwan Affairs Office in Beijing, said China has "indisputable sovereignty" over the Pratas and surrounding waters. "Mainland vessels operating in the relevant waters are entirely legal and justified. We will resolutely safeguard the lives and property of our people," Chen said. Taiwan's "treatment of mainland vessels roughly in a dangerous manner that endangers the lives and property of the personnel involved is maliciously stirring up cross-strait confrontation and they must bear all consequences arising from this," Chen said, without elaborating on the consequences. A Taiwan official with direct knowledge of the situation around the Pratas told Reuters that the Coast Guard carried out "normal law enforcement" during the incident and responded in a "very careful and proportionate way". The Pratas Islands lie roughly between southern Taiwan and Hong Kong. Security experts see them as vulnerable to Chinese attack due to their distance — more than 400 km (250 miles) — from Taiwan. China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory and has increased its military presence around the island over the past five years. The government in Taipei rejects China's claim. China recognises no claims of sovereignty by Taiwan, including over the Pratas Islands, and Chinese coast guard ships have increased patrols. 'GREY ZONE' ACTIVITIES Taiwan says China is increasing its "grey zone" tactics that stop short of outright military action to pressure Taiwan. Speaking at a forum in Taipei, Lii Wen, deputy secretary-general of Taiwan's National Security Council, said China was using a wider range of ships in its "incremental acts of aggression," including militia boats and research vessels. "Grey zone activities under the threshold of conflict have raised serious concerns for their potential to disrupt transportation or damage critical infrastructure," he added. Underscoring the threat Taiwan says it faces, Taiwan's defence ministry flagged another "joint combat readiness patrol" by China near the island on Wednesday, with 13 aircraft including J-16 fighters and an unspecified number of navy ships. China's defence ministry said earlier in the day that the aircraft carrier Liaoning and accompanying ships were drilling in the Western Pacific, though it did not give details. Taiwan's Coast Guard is in charge of day-to-day security for Pratas rather than the military. The Pratas Islands are a national park. They have an airstrip but no permanent civilian population.

item.content:encoded:
午前のドルは158円前半中心にもみ合い、米ＣＰＩ前に様子見 12:23 配信

米ドル紙幣。23年3月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５８円前半を中心にもみ合いとなった。米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の発表を控えて様子見ムードが強い。持ち高調整とみられるフローで一時１５８円半ばまで上昇したが、すぐに押し戻された。

・ドルは１５８円前半を中心にもみ合い

・米ＣＰＩ待ちで手控え、実需売買は閑散

・仲値公示後に１５８．５１円まで上昇

・ＣＰＩ前の持ち高調整との見方

・ＣＰＩがレンジ突破の原動力になるか注目も

＜みなと銀行資金証券部ストラテジストの苅谷将吾氏＞

「米ＣＰＩが予想とほぼ変わらずなら２割強残る１０月利上げの織り込みが剥落し、ドル売りとなる可能性があるが、レンジは抜けないだろう」

「ウォラー米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）理事やニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁の発言などで市場の目線が今月は利上げ見送り方向に向いているため、コアのインフレが上振れれば、ドル買い反応が大きく出るリスクはある」

「ドル／円は２００日移動平均線で上値が抑えられている状況で、抜ければ円買いポジションの巻き戻しも伴って１５９円乗せが視野に入る」

item.title: アングル：ＥＵの自動車現地調達ルール案、中国勢は先回りで足場固め
item.description:
Nick Carey Rachel More
[パリ １３日 ロイター] - 欧州で地場製造業の強化を狙った新たな現地...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：ＥＵの自動車現地調達ルール案、中国勢は先回りで足場固め 12:22 配信

2026年10月12日、パリで開催されたモーターショーで記者会見に臨む小鵬汽車の何小鵬・最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Nick Carey　Rachel More

[パリ １３日 ロイター] - 欧州で地場製造業の強化を狙った新たな現地調達規則の導入が議論されているが、中国の自動車メーカーは既に欧州各地で工場やサプライチェーンの整備を進めている。規則の詳細が固まる前に先手を打ち、市場への足場固めを急いでいる格好だ。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）が検討している「メイド・イン・ヨーロッパ」規則は、既に提案された産業加速化法の一環として、域内での生産や調達を促し欧州の産業基盤を強化することを目的としている。ＥＵ市場への参入を目指す海外メーカーに対しても、欧州での生産拡大や欧州サプライヤーの利用を求める内容になる見通しだ。

こうした構想が打ち出された背景には、中国メーカーが欧州市場で急速にシェアを伸ばし、今後もさらなる参入が見込まれている状況がある。

ただ、この「メイド・イン・ヨーロッパ」を巡っては、どの国を対象地域に含めるべきかについて欧州内部で政治的な意見対立が起きている。一方、中国メーカー各社は結論を待つつもりはないようで、現地化戦略を前倒しで進め、規則が確定する前から欧州での生産体制やサプライヤーネットワークの拡充に取り組んでいる。

世界最大の自動車市場である中国国内で、電気自動車（ＥＶ）の価格競争激化や販売鈍化に直面している中国メーカーにとって、欧州は重要な成長市場という意味合いを持つ。

長安汽車 の幹部の１人は、現在開催中のパリモーターショーで記者団に「欧州での生産能力構築と事業機会の開拓に取り組んでいる」と述べた。この幹部の話では、欧州サプライヤーと踏み込んだ協議を行うため、既に２度欧州を訪問したほか、欧州メーカーとの共同生産についても協議している。

長安汽車は、欧州での年間販売台数を２０２８年までに１８万台、３０年までに３５万台へ拡大する計画だ。同社の社長は、初の欧州生産車を２７年初めにも投入したい考えを示しており、これはＥＵの現地調達規則が発効するとみられる時期よりかなり早い。

小鵬汽車 、奇瑞汽車（チェリー） 、広州汽車集団（ＧＡＣ）, など他の中国メーカーも、欧州のサプライヤーを軸とした現地生産計画を進めている。小鵬汽車のイエチン・ジェン副社長は、欧州での新たな生産能力について「『メイド・イン・ヨーロッパ』規則の発効と同時期に生産を開始したい」と語った。オーストリアでは既にマグナ が小鵬汽車向けＥＶを生産している。

複数の業界関係者からは、中国メーカーの動きがＥＵの政策立案よりも速いことから、最終的な規則がどれほどの効果を持つのか疑問視する声も聞かれる。米自動車業界団体「自動車イノベーション連盟」のジョン・ボゼラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、米国では、欧州は中国メーカーへの対応が遅れた「教訓」と見なされていると明かした。

米上院では中国製自動車を恒久的に禁止する法案の審議が進められており、ボゼラ氏はその背景としてデータ安全保障への懸念があると説明する。「欧州では市場の現実が先に進み、それに対応する形で政策が打ち出されているように見える。一方の米国では、各方面が『問題を事前に解決しよう』としている」と語った。

＜政策で進出阻止困難か＞

パリモーターショーで講演したフォルクスワーゲン のオリバー・ブルーメＣＥＯは「強い欧州は強い産業なしには成り立たない」と述べ、「メイド・イン・ヨーロッパ」への支持を表明した。

とはいえ現在の案ではトルコ、英国、モロッコといったＥＵ非加盟国が対象外で、これらの国々は欧州の自動車産業と深く結び付いた生産・調達拠点となっている。

そのため当該諸国に生産拠点を持つメーカーや業界団体は「欧州」の定義をＥＵ加盟国に限定すれば、長年かけて構築された広域的なサプライチェーンを損なうと反発。トルコ自動車産業輸出業者協会（ＯＩＢ）は、同国の自動車産業がＥＵ域内で２５万人分の雇用を支えていると主張する。

フォードがトルコで生産する電動商用車「トランジット」の場合、部品価値の５０％超がＥＵ域内から調達され、電池はハンガリーやポーランド製で、そのほかドイツやイタリアなどからも部品供給を受けている構図だ。ＯＩＢのケマル・ヤズジュ会長は「われわれはともに成長してきた。トルコは欧州自動車産業の不可欠な一部だ」と強調した。

ＥＵは現地調達規則の策定と並行して、中国との間でハイブリッド車の域内輸入を半分未満に減らす協定もまとめている。

この協定について問われた奇瑞汽車の尹同躍会長は、まず詳細を検討したいと述べるにとどめたが、それ以上に欧州事業の拡大に関心を向けていて「設計も現地で行いたい。現地のエンジニアリング、現地生産、そして現地のサプライチェーンを構築したい」と語った。

自動車アナリストのフェリペ・ムニョス氏は、中国メーカーは「何でも非常に速く実行する能力」を示しており、政策を論じることによって中国勢が欧州進出を思いとどまる公算は乏しいと見込む。

実際、ＥＵが２４年１０月に中国製ＥＶへ追加関税を課した際、多くの中国メーカーは関税対象外のプラグインハイブリッド車へ軸足を移した。ムニョス氏は「メイド・イン・ヨーロッパ」によって中国メーカーにとって事業環境は多少厳しくなると予想しつつも「それでも彼らを止めることはできない」と言い切った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 10/14(水) 12:22 ロイター

item.title: ECB's Lagarde says solution to French debt woes is at home
item.description: France should solve its own debt woes through fiscal policy consolidation, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said on Wednesday, effectively playing down speculation about an ECB intervention in the bond market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France should solve its own debt woes through fiscal policy consolidation, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said on Wednesday, effectively playing down speculation about an ECB intervention in the bond market. French government bonds have been [USN:L8N45S1P0 TEXT:"among the worst hit"] by a global selloff, with investors concerned that political jostling ahead of next year's presidential election may hinder the government's efforts to reduce its high deficit. Asked whether the ECB was about to help France, Lagarde said it was up to Paris to soothe investors' nerves. "There are particular circumstances that lead to some countries being more affected, France being a case in point," she told a CNN event in Bangkok. "And for that one, the primary and first solution lies at home in France. And it has to do with fiscal policies." Analysts have been speculating for weeks about whether the ECB might start buying French bonds via a crisis-fighting tool known as the Transmission Protection Instrument. This can be activated if a country is under market pressure that the ECB deems "unwarranted", "disorderly" and threatening the transmission of the central bank's interest rates to all corners of the euro zone. ECB LOOKS FOR INFLATION 'HINTS', GROWTH IS 'NOT BAD' Asked about monetary policy, Lagarde said the current, high rate of inflation in the euro zone had been driven "predominantly, but not exclusively" by a surge in energy prices caused by the Iran war. While there was no sign yet of "second-round effects" on other prices, the ECB would be looking for "hints", such as trade unions' demands in wage negotiations. "We cannot wait until they're there in full view, but we can anticipate," she said at the event on the sidelines of the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in the Thai capital. "So we very carefully follow those entry points." The ECB [USN:L1N45U0EF TEXT:"has raised rates"] twice in the past four months and is expected to do so again in December. Lagarde said the 1.1% increase in GDP expected by the IMF for the euro zone this year was "not brilliant" but "not a bad outcome" either and flagged continued support from German government spending on infrastructure and the military.

item.description: [東京 １４日 ロイター] - ＳＢＩホールディングスは１４日、吉本興業ホールディングス（大阪市中央区）と、エンターテ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＳＢＩＨＤ、吉本興業ＨＤと業務提携　エンタメＩＰを世界展開 12:19 配信

ＳＢＩグループのロゴ。東京都内で7月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - ＳＢＩホールディングスは１４日、吉本興業ホールディングス（大阪市中央区）と、エンターテインメント領域での戦略的業務提携で基本合意したと発表した。合弁会社を設立し、日本発のエンターテインメントＩＰ（知的財産）の企画・開発や海外展開を推進する。

合弁会社では、吉本興業ＨＤが持つＩＰ資産や映像制作能力と、ＳＢＩグループの資本力や金融テクノロジーを融合し、世界市場を見据えたＩＰの企画・開発・投資を進める。ＳＢＩグループのセキュリティトークン基盤やオンチェーン金融のノウハウを活用し、ＩＰ・コンテンツ領域で新たな資金調達手法の創出にも取り組む。両社は、ＳＢＩグループが組成する１０００億円規模のファンドを活用し、映像作品、興行・イベント、スポーツ、デジタルコンテンツなど幅広いエンターテインメント分野への投資を進める。吉本興業ＨＤも同ファンドに出資する。

ＳＢＩホールディングスは２０２５年５月に、グループのメディア・エンタテインメント・マーケティング関連事業を統括する「ＳＢＩネオメディアホールディングス」を設立。同年６月には世界的に有名なＫ－ＰＯＰの女性グループＢＬＡＣＫＰＩＮＫ（ブラックピンク）のメンバー事務所と戦略的パートナーシップを締結したと発表している。

item.title: Houthis hit Saudi Aramco headquarters with missiles as conflict escalates
item.description: The strike on an office complex in Dhahran caused a limited fire and no injuries, according to Saudi Arabia's energy ministry ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Anthony Di Paola and Annmarie Hordern Saudi Aramco’s executive headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia was hit during a missile attack by Yemen’s Houthi militants on Tuesday, causing a fire in a part of the complex, the kingdom’s energy ministry said. The strike on an office complex in Dhahran caused a limited fire and no injuries, according to the ministry. The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen said Houthi missiles had targeted several cities in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, including the capital Riyadh.  Shrapnel from an interception fell in part of a residential area in Dhahran, the coalition said. Aramco didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. The missiles launches are part of a wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia in recent days that has also targeted airports around the country, which left at least 18 people dead and hundreds injured.  The latest Houthi attacks come after the Saudi coalition had warned people in the vicinity of an oil site in Houthi-held capital Sanaa in Yemen to leave the area “for their safety.” Oil infrastructure in Saudi Arabia has also been targeted during the escalating hostilities with the Houthis.  A refinery at Jazan in the kingdom’s west has been shut since an earlier attack, while a key oil export port on the Red Sea coast has also been targeted. A cross-country pipeline that’s been the main means for Aramco to get its oil to world markets was temporarily shut last month following an attack launched from Iraq.  Dhahran, located along Saudi Arabia’s Persian Gulf coast, is at the heart of the kingdom’s oil economy. In addition to Aramco, the region is home to a university specializing in petroleum engineering and a major air base. Saudi Arabia’s biggest oil fields are located in the deserts of the Eastern Province and in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Judge extends White House access for CNN, MS NOW, Politico amid legal fight
item.description: A federal judge extended access to the White House for CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists, deciding on Tuesday that President Donald Trump likely broke the law when he tried to ban them, in the latest ruling against him in the press freedom dispute.
item.dc:creator: Jack Queen, Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: A federal judge extended access to the White House for CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists, deciding on Tuesday that President Donald Trump likely broke the law when he tried to ban them, in the latest ruling against him in the press freedom dispute. US District Judge Timothy Kelly issued a written decision that elaborated on his September 24 emergency order that reinstated access for the journalists. The news organizations and press freedom groups have accused Trump of unconstitutional retaliation against journalists for coverage he does not like. Kelly's order last month gave the CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists access to the White House grounds on a temporary basis. The judge issued a ruling called a preliminary injunction on Tuesday that will remain in effect until he makes a final judgment in the lawsuit brought by the news organizations, unless an appeals court lifts his order. Kelly wrote that Trump's public remarks made clear that he banned the news outlets because he considered their reporting biased and inaccurate, and not because of national security concerns as government lawyers later asserted in court. "Simply put, that is unlawful viewpoint discrimination," the judge wrote, adding that "no one should read this decision as suggesting that President Trump’s complaints are meritless." Trump appointed Kelly in 2017 during his first presidential term. CAMPAIGN AGAINST THE MEDIA Past presidents have battled with the press, but Trump's campaign against the media has been unprecedented. He has upended decades of tradition by denying basic access to many major news organizations, launching personal attacks on journalists for their reporting and elevating media outlets seen as more sympathetic to the administration. He also has filed lawsuits against multiple news outlets. Trump announced the ban in September on his social media platform, saying CNN, Politico, and MS NOW "shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States." The Justice Department has emphasized Trump's contention that the ban is legally justified on national security grounds. The outlets have said the revocation of their White House passes was unlawful retaliation for their news coverage and accused the Trump administration of manufacturing meritless national security concerns to justify the ban. The outlets said in a lawsuit that the ban violated the US Constitution's First Amendment protections for freedom of speech and a free press, as well as their rights to due process, meaning fair treatment from the government. The White House on September 24 reinstated the CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists after Kelly decided the ban "likely violated their constitutional due process rights," and ordered their access immediately restored. 'COERCE BETTER COVERAGE' The judge held a hearing on October 8 to hear arguments by the news outlets and the Justice Department over whether to extend the protection for the journalists against being barred from the White House. The Justice Department defended the bans as fair and justified. "Here we have the unusual situation where the president himself has said he wants to chill speech. He wants to coerce better coverage," Theodore Boutrous, an attorney for the outlets, told Kelly during the hearing. "CNN, MS NOW and Politico engaged in apparently indefensible conduct," Justice Department lawyer Michael Velchik said. The legal battle is being waged just weeks before the November 3 US midterm elections in which Trump's fellow Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress. Trump's job approval ratings are at record lows in opinion polls amid concerns over issues such as inflation and the Iran war.

item.title: Gold holds firm ahead of US inflation data
item.description: Gold prices held firm on Wednesday as investors braced for US consumer price index data due later in the day for clues on the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy stance.
item.dc:creator: Sukanya Mitra
item.content:encoded: Gold prices held firm on Wednesday as investors braced for US consumer price index data due later in the day for clues on the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy stance. Spot gold held its ground at $4,165.25 per ounce, as of 0447 GMT. U.S. gold futures for December delivery edged 0.3% higher to $4,188.70. "What we're looking at here is not a big move, it's within a range. But the fact that we are able to hold a range while oil is rallying suggests that gold is trying to find a reason to rally," said Ilya Spivak, head of global macro at Tastylive. On the geopolitical front, an administrative building belonging to [USN:L1N45Z0HH TEXT:"Saudi Arabia's"] state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco in the eastern city of Dhahran was attacked, the Energy Ministry said, as fighting between Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis and the kingdom intensified. Oil prices [USN:L1N46000C TEXT:"scaled higher"] on the news on Wednesday. If upcoming consumer price index data, producer price index data and retail sales data point to weaker economic momentum, markets may scale back expectations for further Fed rate hikes this year, providing a bullish catalyst for gold, Spivak added. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is due at 1230 GMT, followed by the Producer Price Index (PPI) and retail sales data on Thursday. New York Fed President [USN:L6N45Z14X TEXT:"John Williams"] reaffirmed his view that the US central bank may need to raise interest rates once more this year in its bid to lower inflation. Meanwhile, Fed Governor [USN:L1N45Z0AY TEXT:"Christopher Waller"] said the recent rise in US bond yields reflects stronger economic growth rather than higher inflation expectations, which remain "well-anchored". Markets are pricing in about a 22% chance of a US rate hike this month and an 88% probability of an increase in December, according to CME's FedWatch Tool. Although gold is typically seen as a hedge against inflation, higher interest rates tend to diminish the appeal of non-yielding bullion to investors. Among other metals, spot silver dipped 0.2% to $59.33 per ounce, platinum steadied at $1,663.16 and palladium gained 0.7% to $1,133.49.

item.title: Rays capitalize on Guardians' error, knot ALCS behind Freddy Peralta
item.description: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Tampa Bay Rays took advantage of an uncharacteristic error by Jose Ramirez to even their American League Championship Series against the Cleveland Guardians on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Tampa Bay Rays took advantage of an uncharacteristic error by Jose Ramirez to even their American League Championship Series against the Cleveland Guardians on Tuesday. Ramirez's miscue opened the door for a three-run frame in the fourth and Freddy Peralta tossed six scoreless innings, fueling the Rays to a 3-1 victory in Game 2 of the best-of-seven series. Liam Hicks recorded a two-run single and joined Jonny DeLuca with two hits for Tampa Bay. Game 3 of the best-of-seven series is Thursday in Cleveland. Peralta (1-0) scattered four hits and struck out six while walking two. The right-hander capped his 99-pitch outing by striking out rookie Petey Halpin to end the sixth. Peralta has allowed one or zero earned runs in eight consecutive outings. "I define myself as a competitor, and I like these kind of games," Peralta said. "... I grew up watching the games in (the Dominican Republic). That's the game that you see. And I'm used to that. I feel that I have that in me." Cleveland rookie Chase DeLauter ripped an RBI double down the right field line to trim Tampa Bay's lead to 3-1 in the seventh. Left-hander Ian Seymour, however, struck out Jo Adell with runners on second and third to end the inning. Seymour retired the side in order in the eighth to bridge the gap to All-Star closer Bryan Baker, who did the same in the ninth to secure his fourth save of the postseason after leading the major leagues with 41 in the regular season. "Makes for a happy flight. Mission accomplished on that front," Baker said. Ramirez misplayed a routine grounder by Ben Williamson, as the ball bounced through the third baseman's legs and into left field to allow Victor Mesa Jr. to score the game's first run in the fourth. "It's a little faster here," Ramirez said of the infield at Tropicana Field, through a club translator. "I was playing parallel to the base and the ball bounced right on the edge between the dirt and the turf. "I tried to knock it down, but I couldn't." Said Guardians manager Stephen Vogt: "Josey kind of got stuck. It looked like he just didn't move his feet. And I don't know if it hit the lip or not on the second hop, but just kind of looked like he sat back a little bit with his feet set instead of moving his feet." Hicks followed by sending the next pitch from All-Star rookie left-hander Parker Messick (0-2) into right-center field to plate Chandler Simpson and Williamson and stake Tampa Bay to a 3-0 lead. "I have to make it count. I have to make them pay for that," Hicks told MLB Network. "That's a team that doesn't make those types of errors. You have to take advantage of any kind of opportunity." Vogt credited the Rays for capitalizing. "They've done that all year. When they smell blood, they take it and run," he said. Earlier in the inning, the Guardians appeared to have turned their third double play in four innings before Tampa Bay successfully challenged the play. Mesa was ruled safe at first base. Tampa Bay third baseman Junior Caminero snared a sharp liner by Steven Kwan in the fifth. Caminero then drew a rise out of the crowd by flashing a finger wag in the manner of former renowned NBA shot blocker Dikembe Mutombo. Messick, a native of nearby Plant City, Fla., permitted three runs (all unearned) on six hits in five innings. He also walked two and hit one batter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jets' No. 1 line erupts for 7 points in win over Wild
item.description: Cole Perfetti scored a pair of goals, including the go-ahead tally, as the Winnipeg Jets pulled away for a 5-2 win over the visiting Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Cole Perfetti scored a pair of goals, including the go-ahead tally, as the Winnipeg Jets pulled away for a 5-2 win over the visiting Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night. Perfetti and his No. 1 linemates, Mark Scheifele (one goal, two assists) and Kyle Connor (one goal, one assist), combined for seven points for Winnipeg, which won for the fourth time in its past five games. Neal Pionk added two assists. Kirill Kaprizov scored both goals for Minnesota, which lost in regulation for only the second time this season. Jets goaltender Stuart Skinner stopped 19 of 21 shots. Wild goaltender Calvin Pickard allowed five goals on 25 shots in his season debut. Winnipeg struck quickly with a goal 1:50 into the game. Pionk unleashed a wrist shot from near the blue line, and Perfetti deflected it just past Pickard's stick side and into the back of the net. The Wild evened the score with 11:13 remaining in the period. Kaprizov poked the puck loose from a Jets defender and headed to the crease on a mini-breakaway. His first shot was stopped but he scored on the rebound. The Jets regained a 2-1 lead with 2:06 left in the period. On the power play, Scheifele set up in the slot and scored his first goal of the season, a one-timer off a pinpoint pass from Pionk. Forty-four seconds later, Kaprizov struck again to even the score at 2-all. He redirected a shot from Quinn Hughes past Skinner for his NHL-leading eighth goal this season. Perfetti provided the go-ahead goal on the power play to make it 3-2 with 3:24 left in the second period. He scored from the slot on a one-timer for his fifth of the season. The Jets increased their lead to 4-2 with 15:54 remaining in the third. Connor carried the puck left to right, wheeled to his forehand and scored on a rising wrist shot for his seventh goal. Cole Koepke scored on a 2-on-1 rush to boost the Jets' lead to 5-2 with 5:18 left. -Field Level Media

item.title: China September rare earth exports rise 6.7% from a year earlier
item.description: China's exports of rare earths in September rose 6.7% from the prior year, customs data showed on Wednesday, as overseas buying improved after a summer lull.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's exports of rare earths in September rose 6.7% from the prior year, customs data showed on Wednesday, as overseas buying improved after a summer lull. The world's largest rare earth producer shipped out 4,269.8 metric tons of the group of 17 minerals essential to electric vehicles, wind turbines and defense technology, data from the General Administration of Customs showed. That was down 9.8% from 4,735 tons in [USN:L4N45007H TEXT:"August"] but was up from 4,000 tons in the [USN:L3N3VU073 TEXT:"same month in 2025"]. In the first nine months of 2026, total exports dropped 9.6% year-on-year to 43,711 tons.

item.title: Thyssenkrupp's largest shareholder sees 'window of opportunity' for steel spin-off
item.description: The head of the Krupp Foundation, the largest shareholder in German conglomerate Thyssenkrupp , believes there is currently a "window of opportunity" to spin off the firm's steel division, according to an interview published on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The head of the Krupp Foundation, the largest shareholder in German conglomerate Thyssenkrupp (TKAG.DE) , believes there is currently a "window of opportunity" to spin off the firm's steel division, according to an interview published on Wednesday. "I have the impression that there is currently a good window of opportunity for such a step," foundation head Ursula Gather said in the interview with the WAZ newspaper. She said she was optimistic due to Thyssenkrupp's [USN:L8N3US0CG TEXT:"restructuring deal"] with the IG Metall union, the [USN:L6N43B0KR TEXT:"sale of its stake"] in steelmaker HKM and [USN:L6N45A0Y0 TEXT:"additional protection"] for Europe's steel industry through EU tariffs. Gather has chaired the board of trustees of the Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach Foundation, which holds just under 21% of the company, since 2013. CEO Miguel Lopez plans to transform the Ruhr-based group into a financial holding company. He has already taken the hydrogen subsidiary Nucera (NCH2.DE) and defence company TKMS (TKMS.DE) public. Its materials trading subsidiary, tk accelis, is set to follow later this year.

item.title: Indian rupee to build on rally after RBI chief reinforces currency support
item.description: The Indian rupee is poised to extend its rally on Wednesday after the central bank's steps to support the currency were reinforced by the governor's indication that further measures remain an option.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee is poised to extend its rally on Wednesday after the central bank's steps to support the currency were reinforced by the governor's indication that further measures remain an option. The rupee is expected to open in the 95.04-95.12 range, traders said, after settling at 95.28 to the dollar on Tuesday. The currency has already surged 1.5% over the past two sessions after the Reserve Bank of India rolled out a series of measures to address the dollar demand-supply imbalance that had kept the rupee under sustained pressure. In a media interview on Tuesday, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra defended the recent forex curbs as an effort to discourage speculative bets. He said the measures were meant to preserve access to currency hedges for businesses with genuine exposure, while signalling that the central bank is ready to take additional steps to ensure orderly rupee movement. Malhotra added that while monetary policy is not typically deployed to address financial stability concerns, the two cannot be entirely separated. "The mandate of price stability cannot be achieved without financial stability, as a stable financial system is essential for the effective transmission of monetary policy," Malhotra said. Bankers read Malhotra's comments as hawkish, with two saying they reinforced the case for a December rate hike, while one said the possibility of a 50 basis point increase was on the table. "The RBI is pulling out all the stops to break the rupee’s prolonged pressure," a currency trader at a bank said. "But the challenge is that the underlying fundamentals remain unfavourable," pointing to oil prices and weak capital flows. Oil prices have continued to push higher, with supply concerns showing little sign of abating. Prices rose on Wednesday, with traders assessing the potential impact of fighting between Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi Arabia on supply.

item.title: Trump campaigns in Alaska, a conservative state feeling the pinch of high energy prices
item.description: With three weeks until the US midterm elections, Donald Trump on Tuesday campaigned in remote Alaska, one of several conservative states where Democrats have a rare chance of flipping a Senate seat amid voter dissatisfaction with the cost of living and the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: With three weeks until the US midterm elections , Donald Trump on Tuesday campaigned in remote Alaska, one of several conservative states where Democrats have a rare chance of flipping a Senate seat amid voter dissatisfaction with the cost of living and the Iran war. Polling has shown Democratic candidate Mary Peltola tied or slightly ahead of incumbent Republican Senator Dan Sullivan in a state the president carried by some 14 percentage points in 2024. Here, as in much of the United States, the president's approval rating is underwater, hit by rising [USN:L6N45L18J TEXT:"diesel and gasoline prices"] and a conflict in the Middle East that has proven deeply unpopular with voters. Energy shocks have an outsize impact on this vast Arctic state, where people depend on heating oil to brave the long winters and many products must be flown, shipped or trucked across vast distances. Opening for Trump , Sullivan acknowledged that Alaskans face "challenges" when it comes to energy costs. But "the conflict in the Middle East is temporary," he said. "The true forever war is the national Democrats' war against Alaska oil and gas and our jobs." Republicans' decision to hold a rally in Wasilla, a deeply conservative town of roughly 10,000 people about 45 minutes north of Anchorage, the state's most populous city, fits an emerging pattern. The president has taken to [USN:L1N45X06G TEXT:"campaigning"] in conservative-leaning parts of competitive states, rather than in more politically diverse areas with more votes potentially up for grabs. The strategy could help turn out his most devoted supporters on election day, analysts say, while keeping Trump far from the independents and political moderates who have soured on his presidency. Soon after taking the stage at a sports complex surrounded by birch, spruce and aspen trees, Trump vowed the Iran war will "end very soon ... and prices will come tumbling down." "I've done more for this state than any other state in the union," the president said, highlighting his administration's efforts to [USN:S0N44100I TEXT:"attract Asian investment"] in an Alaskan pipeline project, fund new power lines and expand high-speed internet access. At one point, Trump pardoned two local repair shop owners who were convicted of violating the federal Clean Air Act for removing pollution controls on diesel engines. He also encouraged Republicans to vote by mail – a process he has repeatedly sought to [USN:L1N44T0X8 TEXT:"curtail"] and [USN:L6N45718O TEXT:"discredit."] Lance Million, 68, a retired foreman from Wasilla who showed up early to Tuesday's rally, expressed dissatisfaction with the Iran war but said he would vote for Sullivan because, "I’m a Republican, a staunch Republican." “I’m a little bit disappointed in Trump for not getting it (the war in Iran) over with in a timely manner," Million said. Still, he said, "we just don’t have any other choice at this point in time because it’s either Sullivan or Peltola.” POLLS LEAN TOWARD DEMOCRATS All 435 seats in the US House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 US Senate seats will be decided on November 3. Public opinion polls suggest Republicans may [USN:L6N45T19V TEXT:"lose control"] of one or both houses of Congress, which would likely limit Trump's ability to enact his policies in the final two years of his presidency. A New York Times/Siena survey released on October 3 showed Peltola, an Alaska Native who served as the state's sole US House representative from 2022 to 2025, leading by 7 percentage points, though some polls point to a much tighter race. Suzanne Downing, the former communications director for the Alaska Republican Party, said fuel prices were weighing on every aspect of rural life and proving a major drag on Republicans. She said Alaskan men in particular were apathetic about voting this cycle - a potential problem for Republicans as they tend conservative. "They like Trump, but they feel like they've been let down," said Downing. Campaigning in Wasilla could help the president "reinvigorate" his base, she added. Sullivan, a former Alaska attorney general, has been a strong advocate for oil and gas drilling, including in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, and has emphasized the state's strategic importance amid growing US competition with Russia and China over control of the Arctic. Peltola made history in 2022 by becoming the first Alaska Native and first woman elected to represent the state in the House of Representatives. She cultivated a pragmatic, bipartisan image and focused on local issues such as fisheries, but lost her 2024 reelection bid to Republican Nick Begich III. Responding to previous criticism from Sullivan over her record, Peltola has said she supports oil and gas development in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and that she is not a typical national Democrat. Jo Bennett, a retired state worker from Anchorage in her 60s who said she has voted for both parties, was among a group of women on Tuesday afternoon putting up placards on an overpass over the highway between Anchorage and Wasilla. Together they read: “War is a pain in the ga$." At a gas station recently, Bennett said, "I about fell over because it was almost $50 to fill my little, pretty-decent-gas-mileage car."

item.title: Blackhawks knock off Penguins in Connor Bedard’s season debut
item.description: Teuvo Teravainen scored twice, including the game-winner with 4:18 left, and Roman Kantserov also had two goals to help the host Chicago Blackhawks defeat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-3 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Teuvo Teravainen scored twice, including the game-winner with 4:18 left, and Roman Kantserov also had two goals to help the host Chicago Blackhawks defeat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-3 on Tuesday. Captain Connor Bedard had an assist in his season debut to help Chicago win the opener of Pittsburgh's four-game road trip. Sidney Crosby had two goals, Nick Robertson also scored and Erik Karlsson collected two assists for the Penguins. Crosby tied the game at 9:17 of the third period, gathering a rebound in front of the net and maneuvering around Blackhawks goaltender Spencer Knight (24 saves). Teravainen put Chicago ahead for good at 15:42 when his long wrist shot from the left circle just in front of the goal line got past Pittsburgh goalie Sergei Murashov (15 saves). Teravainen assisted on Tyler Bertuzzi's empty-netter with 10 seconds left for a three-point night. Kantserov, a rookie winger, enjoyed the first multi-goal game of his career while scoring for the third time in the past two games. Teravainen opened the scoring for the Blackhawks just 28 seconds into the game. Anton Frondell's forecheck forced a turnover behind the Pittsburgh net, and Frondell passed the puck to a charging Teravainen in the slot. Pittsburgh has yielded a goal less than 30 seconds into the game twice in its past four contests. Crosby tied the game at 6:57 of the first period, netting his first goal of the season on a wrist shot from the right circle off a 2-on-1 with Karlsson. Chicago regained the lead on the power play at 17:50. Bedard collected a Bowen Byram pass and one-timed the puck to Kantserov, who sent a snapshot from the slot past Murashov. Kantserov extended the advantage to 3-1 at 10:32 of the second. Artyom Levshunov weaved down the right side and into the circle and found Kantserov for a tap-in in front of the net. Pittsburgh narrowed the deficit to one goal at 17:51 as Robertson scored on a rebound off a rush. He gathered a loose puck in front of the net and wristed a shot past Knight. The puck slid under the back of the net and out but the goal counted. Bertuzzi had a goal and assist and Frondell added two assists. Bedard missed training camp and Chicago's first six games while recovering from surgery on his left shoulder in July. --Field Level Media

item.title: 中国9月輸出、予想上回る前年比＋36.3％ 7カ月ぶり高い伸び
item.description:
Yukun Zhang Ellen Zhang Liz Lee
[北京 １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yukun Zhang　Ellen Zhang　Liz Lee

[北京 １４日 ロイター] - 中国税関当局が１４日発表した９月の輸出（ドル建て）は前年同月比３６．３％増と、予想の２５．５％増を大幅に上回り、今年２月以来の高い伸びとなった。堅調な外需が個人消費の低迷を補い、年間成長率目標の達成に向けた政策当局への圧力が和らいだ。８月の伸び率は２５％だった。

貿易不均衡の是正を求める欧米諸国の圧力にもかかわらず、中国のモノの輸出は２年連続で底堅さを維持。工場の稼働を支え、内需や投資が低迷する中で経済成長を下支えしている。

９月の輸入は３１％増。市場は伸び率が８月の２８．２％から２４．５％に鈍化すると見込んでいた。

１─９月の貿易黒字は９３８１億１０００万ドルに達した。第４・四半期に輸出が急減速しない限り、貿易黒字は昨年より早い時期に１兆ドルを突破する見通しだ。現時点でこうした減速の可能性は低いとみられる。

今月発表された、中国から欧州連合（ＥＵ）へのハイブリッド車輸出を制限する合意は、いずれ中国の好調な自動車貿易の重しとなりそうだ。ただ、貿易措置は１２月から実施される見通しで、輸出業者は駆け込みで出荷を増やす可能性がある。

９月に行われた習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領の首脳会談では、関税を巡る休戦の延長と、双方がそれぞれ３００億ドル相当の品目に対する関税を引き下げることで合意した。

対米輸出は前年比３９．６％増。米国からの輸入は２０．７％増加した。

世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの整備に減速の兆しがほとんど見られない中、アナリストは半導体を含む中国製ハイテク製品への需要が引き続き堅調に推移すると予想している。

好調な輸出は、政策当局が引き続き緩やかな政策支援で年間４．５─５％の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率目標を達成できる可能性を示している。

今後は中国の輸出に対する規制強化がリスクとなる。中国は自国の産業・金融政策を引き続き擁護しているが、米政府とＥＵは、これらの政策が中国の巨額の貿易黒字の背景にあると批判している。

輸出が今や主要な成長エンジンとなる中、同部門が大きな打撃を受ければ、当局は内需の低迷と長年続く不動産市場の低迷に対処するため、景気刺激策の強化を迫られる可能性がある。

item.description:
Hiroko Hamada

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は小反発、ＡＩ関連株に買い戻し 11:52 配信

写真は2020年10月、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は小幅に反発し、前営業日比０．６１％（４１５円６１銭）高の６万８１９３円１３銭となった。前日までの下げの反動で、指数寄与度の大きいＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株に買い戻しが入り、相場を支えた。日経平均は底堅く推移した半面、ＴＯＰＩＸは小幅安となった。

・日経平均は前営業日比０．２４％高でスタートした後、上げ幅を広げ、前場後半に一時０．７４％（４９９円）高の６万８２７６円７３銭まで上昇。前日に大きく下げたＡＩ関連株がきょうは堅調。

・買いが一巡した後は６万８１００円台を軸にもみ合い。今晩公表予定の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）をにらみ様子見も。

・決算など個別材料を手掛かりにした売り買いが活発。前日に決算を発表したイオンは大幅安となった。

・セクター別では、金融株や空運株が軟調。前日に買われたバリュー（割安）株に売り。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．０５％安の４１０８．８０ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆３０５５億１４００万円。

・東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、化学、電機機器など１６業種が値上がり。銀行、証券、商品先物取引、空運など１６業種が値下がりし、鉄鋼は変わらずだった。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６０２銘柄（３８％）、値下がりは９０３銘柄（５８％）、変わらずは４６銘柄（２％）。

＜極東証券経済研究所　代表取締役社長　佐藤俊郎氏＞

「前日の米市場では、中国のメモリーメーカー台頭による競争懸念がありながらも、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（ＳＯＸ指数）は小幅安にとどまっていた。きょうの日本株市場でＡＩ・半導体株が底堅く推移しているのは想定内の動き」

「目先は投資家の関心が決算に向いてくる。足元で出ている半導体関連企業や機械関連の業績は好調で、月末にかけて本格化するハイテク企業の決算への期待も高い。日経平均は今月下旬から上方向を試す展開を見込む」

item.title: サッカー＝ＦＩＦＡ会長に非公表の報酬2.7億円か、規約違反の可能性─報道 - Reuters
item.description: サッカー＝ＦＩＦＡ会長に非公表の報酬2.7億円か、規約違反の可能性─報道 Reuters

item.title: サッカー＝ＦＩＦＡ会長に非公表の報酬2.7億円か、規約違反の可能性─報道
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）のジャンニ・インファンティノ会長（５６）が、２０２６年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米３カ国大会に関連し、非公表の１７２万ドル（約２億７０００万円）という支払いを受けていた可能性が浮上した。米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１３日、報じた。

ＥＳＰＮが入手した米内国歳入庁（ＩＲＳ）の資料によると、インファンティノ会長はＷ杯の管理と運営のためにＦＩＦＡが設立した米国法人「ＦＷＣ２０２６」から２４年に当該の報酬を受け取っていた。これは２４年にＦＩＦＡがインファンティノ会長に支払った４９０万ドル相当の報酬とは別で、この追加分は同連盟の同年の報告書には記載されていなかったという。

ＦＩＦＡは規約により、会長や評議会メンバー、事務局長個人の報酬は公表するものと定めており、当該の支払いの不記載は規約違反となる可能性がある。

ＦＩＦＡの広報担当者はＥＳＰＮに対し、規約違反の疑いについては「強く否定する」とコメント。同連盟は声明で「会長に対して二重の給与支払いは行っておらず、報酬についてはすべての報告義務を果たしている」とし、「財務情報の開示を怠り、規約に違反したといういかなる主張も断固として否定する」と述べている。

item.title: Soccer viewership in US surging since World Cup
item.description: Record ratings for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States have carried over to U.S. viewership of the sport's top leagues since July, according to Nielsen research findings announced Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Record ratings for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States have carried over to U.S. viewership of the sport's top leagues since July, according to Nielsen research findings announced Tuesday. Nielsen's Fan Insights data showed that the number of U.S. residents identifying as soccer fans increased 13%, from 66.8 million in July 2025 to 75.2 million in July 2026. Over the past five years, soccer fandom in the U.S. has grown 27%, an increase of 16 million fans. Major League Soccer has seen a 28% boost, adding 11.7 million fans. The findings were unveiled Tuesday at the Front Office Sports Tuned In summit. Spain's 1-0 victory over Argentina in the World Cup final on July 19 averaged 66.4 million viewers in the United States, the largest audience for a soccer match in U.S. history and the most viewers for an American television broadcast since Super Bowl LX in February, when the New England Patriots faced the champion Seattle Seahawks. "The FIFA World Cup 2026 has served as a powerful catalyst for soccer's explosive growth across North America," Nielsen global head of sports Seth Ladetsky said in a statement. "Our data shows that fandom is not only reaching record highs, but it is also expanding rapidly among younger, diverse audiences and carrying over into major domestic and international leagues." Audiences for MLS regular-season games shown on Fox and FS1 after the World Cup break rose 55% among men ages 18-34 and 29% among adults ages 18-34 compared with regular-season matches before the tournament. "The journey started when the World Cup was granted -- it didn't start this summer," MLS commissioner Don Garber said onstage at the Tuned In summit. "What we're looking for as a sport is to grow the market. When I came into MLS, there was no market. ... Our first goal was to build a market where we could come in and deliver something for local fans. And we did that over a period of time. ... Now you've got to have the product that people care about. And frankly, that's just about money and development." Audiences for England's Premier League matches on NBC and USA Network, including Spanish-language broadcasts, have risen 30% among U.S. adults ages 18-34, according to Nielsen. Viewership for Spain's LaLiga on ESPN, ESPN2, ABC and ESPN Deportes has risen 42% year over year across English- and Spanish-language broadcasts, including a 60% increase among viewers ages 18-34. --Field Level Media

item.title: Kyle Palmieri nets pair as Islanders keep Canucks reeling
item.description: Kyle Palmieri scored his first two goals since returning from a knee injury, including the tiebreaking tally in the third period, as the New York Islanders edged the visiting Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kyle Palmieri scored his first two goals since returning from a knee injury, including the tiebreaking tally in the third period, as the New York Islanders edged the visiting Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Tuesday night. The goals were Palmieri's first since Nov. 18, when he scored 10 days before suffering a season-ending torn left ACL. The multi-goal game was the first for Palmieri since he scored a pair for the Islanders against the St. Louis Blues on Nov. 23, 2024. Mattias Maccelli scored a goal and added an assist, and Matthew Schaefer collected two assists for the Islanders, who have split their first six games. Ilya Sorokin made 24 saves. Max Sasson and Brock Boeser scored for the Canucks, who have lost the first four games of their six-game Eastern road trip and five straight overall. Leevi Merilainen recorded 35 saves. Palmieri and Maccelli scored 53 seconds apart late in the first period. Matthew Kessel's shot from the blue line glanced off Palmieri's stick and floated over Merilainen's shoulder with 5:03 left in the period. Maccelli, who spent last season with the Toronto Maple Leafs, scored his first goal for the Islanders following a Vancouver turnover. Schaefer intercepted a clearing pass by Canucks defenseman Zeev Buium and dished the puck to Maccelli, who skated into the lower left faceoff circle before beating Merilainen on the stick side at 15:50. Sasson began the Canucks' comeback bid 7:52 into the second period. Arshdeep Bains shoveled a pass beyond Tony DeAngelo to Sasson, who swooped between DeAngelo and Kessel and fired a shot under Sorokin's glove. Palmieri was called for tripping, setting up Boeser's game-tying goal with 1:05 left in the second. Filip Hronek, at the top of the slot, passed to Elias Pettersson, who fed Boeser. The right winger dropped to one knee and fired a shot past Sorokin, who was screened by teammates Adam Pelech and Ryan Pulock as well as Vancouver's Jake DeBrusk. Palmieri redeemed himself by scoring the eventual game-winning goal 5:38 into the third period. Maccelli collected the rebound of Schaefer's shot and passed to Palmieri, who scored from the high slot with Merilainen screened by Buium. --Field Level Media

item.title: グーグル、新旗艦ＡＩモデルを公開 開発競争で巻き返しへ
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - 米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは１３日、新たな旗艦人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「ジェミニ４アルゴン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
グーグル、新旗艦ＡＩモデルを公開　開発競争で巻き返しへ 11:46 配信

写真はジェミニ・アプリのアイコン。2025年10月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[１３日 ロイター] - 米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは１３日、新たな旗艦人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「ジェミニ４アルゴン」を世界の開発者と企業向けに公開した。数カ月にわたる開発の遅れや同社のＡＩ研究子会社ディープマインドにおける経営陣の刷新を経て、競合するオープンＡＩやアンソロピックに対して巻き返しを図る狙いだ。

グーグルによると、このモデルはプログラミング、金融、法務、サイバーセキュリティー、科学といった分野における複雑で多段階の作業、いわゆる「ディープワーク」に優れている。提供開始時のＡＰＩ料金は入力トークン１００万件当たり２ドル、出力トークン１００万件当たり１０ドルからで、１１月３０日以降は料金が２倍になる予定だ。

グーグルは９月、スンダー・ピチャイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が当初６月に公開すると表明していた「ジェミニ３．５プロ」について、リリースしない方針を発表した。

またディープマインドでは、共同創業者のデミス・ハサビスＣＥＯが経営の一線から退き、「ジェミニ」モデルの開発を率いてきた複数の幹部も退社したことを受け、経営陣が刷新された。

アルゴンは、同社のＡＩアプリケーション開発ツールを利用する有料顧客向けに提供される。「グーグルＡＩプロ」および「グーグルＡＩアルトラ」の契約者は、「ジェミニ」アプリや検索サービスの「ＡＩモード」を通じて利用できる。一方、コーディング支援ツール「アンティグラビティー」はアルトラ契約者に限定される。

このモデルを早期に試験導入した顧客には、デロイト、レクシスネクシス、アンビエンス・ヘルスケアなどが含まれる。

item.title: 「株式60／債券40」戦略、米投資家で復活の動き 債券利回り上昇で
item.description:
Patturaja Murugaboopathy
[１３日 ロイター] - 米国の投資家が、伝統的な「株式６０％／債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
「株式60／債券40」戦略、米投資家で復活の動き　債券利回り上昇で 11:44 配信

Patturaja Murugaboopathy

[１３日 ロイター] - 米国の投資家が、伝統的な「株式６０％／債券４０％」のポートフォリオ戦略を再評価している。国債価格が急落して利回りが上昇し、インカムゲイン（利息収入）の魅力が増して将来的なリターンの向上も期待できる水準になったためだ。

２００８年の金融危機以降、超低金利によって債券に資産分散以上の価値が乏しくなったことから、投資家は株式比率を高め、６０／４０戦略は敬遠されるようになっていた。

また債券価格が株式と連動して上昇するようになったことで、逆相関関係が崩れ、分散の効果も薄れていた。

しかし足元の利回り上昇によって状況は変わった。一部年限の米国債利回りが５％を超えたことでインカムゲインが増え、多くの投資家はそれが債券価格の下落に対するクッションになるとみている。

原油価格の上昇と、インフレやソブリン債務への懸念を背景に、米国からドイツ、日本に至るまで債券利回りは数十年ぶりの高水準に上昇したが、多くのアナリストは利回りがピークに近いとみている。

ＳＭＢＣグループのニューヨークを拠点とする金利ストラテジスト、モンティ・ガンディ氏は、供給要因を主とするインフレショックの連鎖が６０／４０戦略を採るポートフォリオに打撃を与えたが、現在の利回り水準であれば債券への資産配分は正当化されやすいと説明。「この水準であれば、個人的には債券を買う方が理にかなっていると思う。良好なキャリーが得られる」と語った。

バンク・オブ・アメリカの１０月版ファンドマネジャー調査によると、投資家が株式から債券への本格的なシフトに踏み切るには、米１０年国債利回りが約５．９％まで上昇する必要があると考えられている。

ドバイを拠点とするスリー・ピンズ・キャピタルのシニア・エグゼクティブ・オフィサー、ラジャト・クマール氏は、１０年国債利回りが５．５％に向かって上昇すれば米経済が大幅に減速し、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ余地が狭まり、現在の利回りを確保しておくべき根拠が強まると話した。

ロイヤル・ロンドン・アセット・マネジメントは８月と９月前半、インフレ懸念から債券のアンダーウェート度合いを強めたが、９月後半には方針を転換し、債券を「買い増し」てアンダーウェート・ポジションの利益を確定したとことを明らかにした。

ファンド動向を見ると、投資家は選別的に投資している。ＬＳＥＧリッパーのデータによれば、９月に投資家は短期米国債ファンドに１４５億ドル、ローン・パーティシペーション・ファンドに４９億ドルを投入した一方、社債ファンドから４９億ドル、高利回り債ファンドから４５億ドルを引き揚げた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 最終更新: 10/14(水) 11:44 ロイター
