item.title: SEC media days: Missouri coach standing by Mark Mitchell in eligibility fight
item.description: Missouri head coach Dennis Gates wasn't scheduled to appear at the SEC's preseason media days until Wednesday, but he got his appearance in Birmingham, Ala., changed to Tuesday for a very important reason
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Missouri head coach Dennis Gates wasn't scheduled to appear at the SEC's preseason media days until Wednesday, but he got his appearance in Birmingham, Ala., changed to Tuesday for a very important reason Gates plans to be with Mark Mitchell in court on Wednesday as the star forward attempts to gain a fifth season of NCAA eligibility. "I am used to it. I don't look at it like a problem," Gates said of the Tigers' uncertain roster three weeks away from the start of the new season. "I've never been given a silver spoon. I've always had to do more with less. I've always had to make decisions at the last minute, last second, but also it allows me to show that I'm talented in what I'm doing. "I'm a CEO, not just a basketball coach. I know how to manage people, manage egos, but also manage a locker room." Mitchell was not selected in this summer's NBA draft. At one point he agreed to an Exhibit 10 contract with the Denver Nuggets, but crucially, he did not sign it. Mitchell also attempted to transfer to Kentucky, but he soon changed course once it became clear the SEC's rule against intraconference transfers would stand in the way, as Mitchell did not enter the portal during the appropriate window. That didn't make Gates think twice about singing the praises of Mitchell, who scored 18.3 points per game and shot 38.8% from 3-point range last season. "When we were 0-19, that young man stepped foot on our campus and the last two years we were able to go to the NCAA Tournament," Gates said. "I'll always be there for Mark Mitchell, man, without a doubt. ... It's about stepping foot, lockstep with them every step of the way, so that they can know that they are supported." The Tigers could be in line for a big year. They were selected eighth in the SEC preseason media poll, on the strength of not just Mitchell but five-star freshmen Jason Crowe Jr. and Toni Bryant. Missouri also has former DePaul leading scorer CJ Gunn in the mix, but again, the program is waiting on an eligibility ruling in his case. "I don't want to sign or would sign anybody that distracts or would distract our locker room," Gates said. "So there was no cutting (players to add Mitchell and Gunn). There was no manipulation." --Alabama coach Nate Oats said he "couldn't be more proud" of Aden Holloway after the former five-star prospect went through a pretrial diversion program for drug charges earlier this year. Holloway is serving a five-game suspension to start the season -- three exhibitions and two regular-season games. He was arrested just before the NCAA Tournament for felony drug possession after authorities said they recovered 2.1 pounds of marijuana from his apartment. His charges have been dismissed. "On the Aden front, I addressed it last week, but super proud of him," Oats said. "He's applied himself consistently over the last few months. Did all the work required to get all the charges dropped. Back in the program I couldn't be more proud of a young man of what he's done over the summer and the fall so far." Holloway averaged 16.8 points and 3.8 assists per game and was an all-SEC selection last year. Oats said Amari Allen will take on the role of primary ball-handler while Holloway is out. --Mark Byington relied heavily on transfers in his first two seasons at Vanderbilt -- and he'll have two transfers with SEC experience this season, T.O. Barrett (Missouri) and Sebastian Williams-Adams (Auburn). But Byington was excited to report that the Commodores are projected to be the second-youngest team in the power conferences this season. "(John Calipari has) got the youngest at Arkansas, but we're right behind them," Byington said. "That's something I know he's used to, and we're getting used to it." Byington said he expects to see his group's youth when they're up against opponents rife with fifth-year players. "But I made a decision, in the current state of college basketball, to believe in the guys I promised something to, the guys I recruited," Byington said. "At the same time, I think you're going to see us continue to get better throughout the year." Seven freshmen are listed on Vanderbilt's roster, including four-star recruits Ethan Mgbako, Anthony Brown and Jackson Sheffield. The Commodores were sixth in the preseason media poll, one spot behind Alabama. --Steven Pearl is approximately one year removed from taking over for his father Bruce Pearl, who retired weeks before the 2025-26 season commenced. Auburn narrowly missed out on the NCAA Tournament in Year 1 under the younger Pearl, but at least one of his players can see a difference entering Year 2. "This year, it's his team," guard Kevin Overton said. "He put together the roster, so he can coach us how he wants... More comfortable. But his approach has always been the same. He wants to win games. You know how bad he wants to win." Steven Pearl, who noted that "You don't realize how valuable an offseason is until you finally have one," said it was a boon for his players and his program to run the table in the NIT and lift the trophy in April. "I wouldn't trade it for anything. I'm glad we did it," Pearl said. "I thought it was really important as a first-year head coach to teach our guys a valuable lesson in life. When something doesn't go your way, you can't just quit. You've got to see things through. ... I thought they had a lot of fun those last four games, really competing." --Patience may be thin in Oklahoma for Porter Moser, who was brought back for a sixth season to coach the Sooners with a promise of increased NIL funds. The Sooners have made just one NCAA Tournament in Moser's first five years, and the media poll picked them 12th in the 16-team league. Moser revealed that one of his most famous conference rivals checked in on him in the middle of a rough patch last season: Arkansas' John Calipari. "You can listen to a lot of things," Moser said. "I've known Cal for many years. I respect him so much when he says that. ... Cal is one of those guys that he's a coaching friend, man, to a lot of people, to the ones he knows and ones that he doesn't. Everybody gets a call when things are going great. Cal is one of those guys that will text or call you and check on you when you're not." --Field Level Media

item.title: China's September exports blow past forecasts, imports accelerate
item.description: China's export growth topped forecasts in September, with robust overseas demand helping offset weak consumer spending and easing pressure on policymakers to deliver this year's growth goal.
item.dc:creator: Yukun Zhang, Ellen Zhang, Liz Lee
item.content:encoded: China's export growth topped forecasts in September, with robust overseas demand helping offset weak consumer spending and easing pressure on policymakers to deliver this year's growth goal. Resilience in goods exports has for a second year defied pressure from Western countries seeking more balanced trade with China, keeping factories humming and shoring up economic growth against subdued domestic demand and investment. Exports in September soared 36.3% from a year earlier, outstripping August's 25.0% rise and far exceeding expectations for 25.5% growth, customs data showed on Wednesday. September's growth was the fastest since February this year when exports expanded 39.6%. Imports jumped 31.0%, compared with 28.2% growth in August and economists' forecasts of a 24.5% gain. China's trade surplus reached $938.11 billion in the first nine months of the year, putting the manufacturing powerhouse on course to surpass $1 trillion in surplus sooner than last year unless exports slow sharply in the final quarter. For now, such a slowdown appears unlikely. A [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"deal"] with the European Union to limit Chinese exports of hybrid vehicles to the bloc, announced earlier this month, is likely to weigh on China's booming auto trade over time. But with the trade measures likely being laid out in [USN:L6N45Y0JN TEXT:"December"], exporters may drive up shipments to beat the deadline. President Xi Jinping's September summit with US President Donald Trump in Washington secured an [USN:L1N45F0IM TEXT:"extension"] to their tariff truce and an agreement to [USN:L6N45K03P TEXT:"cut tariffs"] on $30 billion worth of goods from each side. With the global build-out of AI infrastructure showing little sign of slowing, analysts expect demand for Chinese-made technology products, including semiconductors, to remain robust. China's [USN:L1N460014 TEXT:"factory-gate prices"] rose at their fastest pace in more than four years in September, separate data showed, while consumer inflation edged up but lagged forecasts, underscoring an uneven recovery. The strength in exports, however, indicates that policymakers could still bank on moderate policy support to meet China's 4.5% to 5% annual GDP growth target. The Canton Fair, China's largest trade exhibition, will kick off on Thursday for Chinese manufacturers to showcase their wide array of products to foreign buyers. Going forward, risks of curbs on Chinese exports loom as China continues to defend its industrial and monetary policies, which Washington and Brussels blame for Beijing's massive trade surplus. China's central bank last week [USN:L6N45U0ON TEXT:"pushed back"] against criticism of its exchange-rate policy with a lengthy policy statement, arguing that it never pursued competitive depreciation and rejecting claims that China keeps the yuan artificially weak to gain a trade advantage. As exports now serve as a key growth engine, any major hit to the sector could in turn prompt policymakers to step up stimulus measures to address weak domestic demand and the years-long property market downturn.

item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は、同国の企業はイラン戦争によるエネルギ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英企業、エネ高騰でコスト抑制に注力　労働市場に影響も＝英中銀総裁 11:39 配信

写真はイングランド銀行のベイリー総裁。2026年7月、ロンドンで撮影。Henry Nicholls/REUTERS

[１３日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は、同国の企業はイラン戦争によるエネルギー価格急騰を受けてコスト抑制に注力していると述べた。

１３日に放送された米ＣＮＮとのインタビューで、エネルギー価格急騰による英物価全般への上昇圧力はこれまでのところ抑えられているとする従来の見解をあらためて示しながらも、「現状が長引くほど厳しい状況となる」と述べた。

また、ＢＯＥは英経済がこれまで示してきた底堅さを考慮するものの、企業が慎重な姿勢を取っている兆候があると指摘。「各地を回って企業と数多く対話していると、企業がコストの増加を目の当たりにして抑制に非常に力を入れている状況が見られる」と述べた。

さらに、コスト削減重視の姿勢は労働市場に影響する可能性があるとしながらも、エネルギー価格急騰が賃金などに及ぼす影響を見極めるにはなお「時期尚早」だと述べた。

ＢＯＥはイラン戦争開始以降、政策金利を据え置いており、利上げに踏み切った欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）と異なる姿勢を取っている。

だが投資家は、１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げがほぼ確実に行われるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/14(水) 11:39 ロイター

item.title: IMF says Britain does not need to speed up fiscal consolidation
item.description: The International Monetary Fund is not recommending that Britain speed up its fiscal consolidation to reduce its budget deficit faster, a senior IMF official said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: David Milliken
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund is not recommending that Britain speed up its fiscal consolidation to reduce its budget deficit faster, a senior IMF official said on Wednesday. "Our recommendation is 'stay the course'. We are not saying 'accelerate the pace of consolidation'," fiscal affairs director Rodrigo Valdes said during IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, drawing a contrast with other big economies that have little or no plans to reduce borrowing at a time of rising interest rates. The British government, which ran a budget deficit of 4.4% of GDP last year, aims to balance day-to-day non-investment spending with tax revenue by the 2029/30 financial year – but previous governments regularly failed to meet similar goals. Finance minister John Healey, who arrives at the IMF meetings on Wednesday, will deliver his first annual budget on October 28. He faces extra spending demands from higher debt interest costs and pressures to spend more on defence and energy subsidies, as well as rising welfare costs. Asked if Britain should raise taxes or cut other areas of spending to fund defence, Valdes said many European countries faced similar challenges. "In general ... the space for a lot more revenue, it's not easy. It distorts at the end of the day. So the discussion about the social contract behind spending is very, very urgent," he said. British tax revenue as a share of gross domestic product is close to its highest since just after World War Two, although it is lower than in other European countries with more generous public pensions and welfare systems.

item.description:
Rachel More Giulio Piovaccari
[パリ １３日 ロイター] - 欧州自動車メーカー各社の幹...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州自動車各社、中国勢との競争激化で政策支援要請　ＥＶ移行も課題 11:36 配信

写真はフォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）のオリバー・ブルーメＣＥＯ。2026年10月13日、フランス・パリで撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Rachel More　Giulio Piovaccari

[パリ １３日 ロイター] - 欧州自動車メーカー各社の幹部からは１３日、中国メーカーとの競争や電気自動車（ＥＶ）への移行に対応するため、政策当局にさらなる支援を求める声が相次いだ。欧州メーカーはＢＭＷとステランティスの第３・四半期の販売実績が減少し、業界が直面する逆風の強さが浮き彫りになっている。

フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）のオリバー・ブルーメ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、パリモーターショーに合わせて開かれたイベントで、欧州の大衆車市場が「非常に大きな圧力」にさらされていると述べ、規制の柔軟化や域内生産を支える優遇措置を改めて求めた。

ブルーメ氏は「輸出で得られる利益だけに、われわれの未来を託すことはできない。欧州事業は収益性と強靱性を備え、競争力を持たなければならない」と指摘。「欧州の産業基盤を守らなければならない」と強調した。

ステランティス のアントニオ・フィロサＣＥＯは、欧州ではＥＶ用バッテリー工場をさらに増やす必要があると発言。ルノー のフランソワ・プロボＣＥＯは自動車メーカーに課された２０３０年の排出削減目標について、政策当局が柔軟な対応を示さなければ、ルノーは欧州での生産を約３０万台削減せざるを得なくなる可能性があると警告した。

欧州自動車メーカーへの圧力はＢＭＷの実績にも表れた。同社の第３・四半期の世界納車台数は前年同期比６．４％減少し、中国では４分の１落ち込んだ。

ステランティスも第３・四半期の納車台数が１％減少したと発表。北米で夏季に実施した生産停止が響いた。一方で欧州向け出荷台数は１０％増加。提携する中国新興自動車メーカー浙江零跑科技（リープモーター・テクノロジー） の車両が欧州での出荷増加に寄与した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか 焦点：中国の省エネシフト加速、燃料需要が急減　ＥＶ普及など 最終更新: 10/14(水) 11:36 ロイター

item.title: China, North Korea to open long-delayed bridge on Thursday
item.description: The long-delayed New Yalu River Bridge linking China and North Korea will open on Thursday, Chinese state news agency Xinhua said on Wednesday, signalling a renewed push to boost trade despite Pyongyang's lingering wariness of greater economic dependence.
item.dc:creator: Liz Lee, Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: The long-delayed New Yalu River Bridge linking China and North Korea will open on Thursday, Chinese state news agency Xinhua said on Wednesday, signalling a renewed push to boost trade despite Pyongyang's lingering wariness of greater economic dependence. The two sides will jointly hold an opening ceremony, the Xinhua report said. North Korea's state media did not immediately report on the plan. The bridge will be the largest and most significant land crossing for trade between the two countries. China completed its side of the bridge in 2014, [USN:L8N45U017 TEXT:"hoping to boost trade ties"], although North Korea left its approach roads and customs facilities unfinished as relations soured over Pyongyang's nuclear tests and the UN sanctions that followed. The opening of the new bridge signals further progress in bilateral relations between Beijing and Pyongyang, weeks after North Korea opened its [USN:L6N44Z0JD TEXT:"first road bridge"] with Russia. The North's ties with Moscow have advanced rapidly since their leaders' meeting in 2023. China's exports to North Korea rose to a six-year high of $2.3 billion last year, a 25% increase over the previous year. That was still well below levels before UN sanctions were tightened in 2017. China and Russia have since questioned the legitimacy of the UN Security Council resolutions that they had voted to pass and have been accused by countries such as South Korea and the US of conducting trade and exchanges in breach of the sanctions. China is by far North Korea's largest trading partner, but the opening of the new bridge carries added significance as the isolated state expands external exchanges after the pandemic amid Pyongyang's efforts to balance relations with its two key economic and strategic partners. North Korea and Russia opened a road bridge last month across the Tumen River, adding another transport link as Pyongyang expands economic and strategic cooperation with Moscow. The 3-km (2-mile) dual-carriageway bridge connects the Chinese border city of Dandong with Sinuiju in North Korea and is intended to replace the ageing, single-lane Sino-Korean Friendship Bridge as the main route for road trade. Cho Han-bum, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification in Seoul, said further putting off the opening could have been a source of unwanted strains for both, even as Pyongyang remains cautious of greater economic dependence on China. “There is always both wariness and cooperation in North Korea-China relations,” he said.

item.title: Australian court dismisses Cosette appeal to drop Mayne Pharma takeover
item.description: Australia's New South Wales Court of Appeal on Wednesday rejected Cosette Pharmaceuticals' bid to terminate its takeover of Mayne Pharma , upholding a lower court ruling that the US-based drugmaker had no valid grounds to abandon the deal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's New South Wales Court of Appeal on Wednesday rejected Cosette Pharmaceuticals' bid to terminate its takeover of Mayne Pharma (MYX.AX) , upholding a lower court ruling that the US-based drugmaker had no valid grounds to abandon the deal. Here are some of the details: Cosette bid [USN:L1N3WX01N TEXT:"A$7.40 per share"] for Mayne in February last year but later tried to back out, saying a deterioration in Mayne's financial performance constituted a material adverse change that voided the agreement. The NSW Court of Appeal upheld the trial judge's finding that the decline in Mayne's sales performance was insufficient to meet the threshold for a material adverse change under the scheme implementation deed. The appeal court held that through its conduct at the first court hearing on the scheme, Cosette had chosen to affirm the deed, giving up any right it may have had to terminate. The court rejected Cosette's claim that Mayne had misled it regarding its expected 2025 earnings performance. It ordered Cosette to pay the legal costs of the appeal. Mayne Pharma will continue to pursue claims for damages against Cosette, parent Cosette Pharmaceuticals Holdings, and controllers David Burgstahler and Avista Capital on behalf of itself and its shareholders, Mayne Pharma Chair Bruce Robinson said. "Mayne Pharma remains committed to continuing to maximise shareholder value and remains focused on continuing to strengthen the business," Robinson said. The A$672 million ($470.13 million) takeover has faced political opposition, with South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas criticising the transaction. Federal Treasurer Jim Chalmers [USN:L1N3WX01N TEXT:"blocked"] the deal in November last year on national interest grounds. Shares of Mayne Pharma rose as much as 11% to A$2.820, logging their best intraday session in more than two months, after trading resumed. Cosette has until November 11 to appeal the decision in the High Court, Mayne Pharma said. ($1 = 1.4294 Australian dollars)

item.title: Pius Suter, Mason McTavish help Blues wallop Senators 7-2
item.description: Pius Suter and Mason McTavish each had two goals and an assist in the St. Louis Blues' 7-2 win over the host Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Pius Suter and Mason McTavish each had two goals and an assist in the St. Louis Blues' 7-2 win over the host Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night. Jake Neighbours scored twice and rookie defenseman Adam Jiricek got his first career goal in his sixth game for the Blues, who won their second straight. Pavel Buchnevich had three assists, Connor McMichael added two assists and Joel Hofer made 15 saves. Claude Giroux and Fabian Zetterlund scored for the Senators in their second of back-to-back games and third in four nights. Samuel Ersson stopped 19 shots. Suter's short-handed goal with 5:32 left in the first period gave St. Louis a 1-0 lead. He went in on a partial breakaway after taking a pass from defenseman Colton Parayko for the sixth short-handed goal of Suter's career. Neighbours made it 2-0 with 6:40 remaining in the second when he beat Ersson from above the high slot. Giroux closed the gap to 2-1 with 2:08 left in the middle period when he connected from the top portion of the right circle. It was thanks to an outstanding effort from Tim Stutzle to get a free puck at the left of the net and then pass to Giroux, who tied Hall of Famer Bobby Hull for 59th all-time with 1,170 points. But McTavish restored the two-goal margin 33 seconds later when he capped a 3-on-2 rush by backhanding the puck into an open net from the top of the crease. Suter's second goal 7:54 into the third period made it 4-1, when his harmless-looking shot from just above the goal line in the left corner went into the short side off Ersson. Neighbours got his second goal with 5:14 left by slamming Buchnevich's pass across the top of the crease into the open side of the net. McTavish's second tally and Jiricek's goal came in the final five minutes. Zetterlund picked up a power-play goal for Ottawa with 1:27 left. Senators defenseman Nikolas Matinpalo was out after suffering an upper-body injury Monday. Ottawa continued to be without top-four defensemen Jake Sanderson (lower body) and Artem Zub (knee). --Field Level Media

item.title: Kraken top Flyers in shootout; Philadelphia winless in first eight
item.description: Bobby McMann scored in regulation and then netted the decisive goal in the shootout as the visiting Seattle Kraken nipped the winless Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Bobby McMann scored in regulation and then netted the decisive goal in the shootout as the visiting Seattle Kraken nipped the winless Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday. Ville Ottavainen scored the other regulation goal for the Kraken, who improved to 3-0-0 on their five-game road trip. Seattle goaltender Philipp Grubauer made 24 saves through overtime and then stopped four of five attempts in the shootout. Philadelphia dropped to 0-5-3 on the season, continuing the longest winless start to a campaign in team history. Christian Dvorak and Trevor Zegras scored a goal apiece while Dan Vladar finished with 29 saves and notched an assist. After Grubauer stopped Zegras to open the shootout, Matty Beniers snapped a shot five-hole through Vladar. Matvei Michkov countered with a goal following a series of moves near the crease. That would be the last goal until the fifth round, when McMann placed a perfect shot into the top-left corner to end it. The Flyers trailed 2-0 after two periods before scoring two goals in 1:13 early in the third. Dvorak got them on the board at 6:07 with a goal off a feed from rookie defenseman Oliver Bonk. Zegras got them even at 7:20 as he converted a Travis Sanheim setup for his first goal of the season. In overtime, Philadelphia was whistled for too many men on the ice with 2:39 remaining. The Kraken controlled the action for most of the man advantage but were unable to pot a game-winner. Seattle took a 1-0 lead 7:57 into the contest on McMann's power-play goal. It doubled the lead 8:54 into the second period on Ottavainen's shot through traffic. Zegras was whistled for two penalties in the second period, both involving scrums with Grubauer after the whistle. At one point in that stretch, Seattle had a 5-on-3 for 38 seconds, although Philadelphia's defense held firm, setting the stage for the third-period comeback. --Field Level Media

item.title: Indian shares muted as oil prices, foreign outflows offset IT rebound
item.description: Indian shares were little changed in morning trade on Wednesday as a rebound paused, with rising oil prices and sustained foreign outflows weighing on sentiment while investors assess corporate earnings.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran
item.content:encoded: Indian shares were little changed in morning trade on Wednesday as a rebound paused, with rising oil prices and sustained foreign outflows weighing on sentiment while investors assess corporate earnings. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) added 0.07% to 22,738.05, while the BSE Sensex (.BSESN) edged 0.13% higher to 73,128.50 as of 09:46 a.m. IST. They swung between 0.2% gains and 0.2% losses in morning trade. Eight of the 16 major sectors logged losses. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) were little changed. IT index (.NIFTYIT) , which gained 5.2% in the previous session, added 1.2% on the day. Both the Nifty and Sensex (.BSESN) climbed about 1.6% on [USN:L4N45Z0KR TEXT:"Tuesday"], led by information technology stocks after HCLTech's (HCLT.NS) [USN:L6N45Z08A TEXT:"quarterly profit"] beat expectations. "Despite the sharp rebound, persistent macroeconomic uncertainties continue to warrant a cautious approach from investors," said Ajit Mishra, senior vice president of research at Religare Broking. Oil prices rose to about $107 a barrel as traders weighed supply risks from fighting between Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis and Saudi Arabia against the prospect of increased diesel supplies from Russia. Foreign portfolio investors (FPI) remained net sellers of domestic stocks for the 13th consecutive session on Tuesday, taking the year-to-date outflows to a record $32.52 billion. "The market has officially entered an 'earnings override' regime, while bias is neutral to rangebound, the undertone is cautious below 23,000 for the Nifty," said Hemang Gor, senior research analyst of derivatives and technical research at Axis Direct. Among stocks, Tata Elxsi (TTEX.NS) climbed 7.8% after the engineering research and development firm [USN:L4N45Z17R TEXT:"posted"] higher quarterly profit, supported by growth in its transportation and media segments. Bharat Coking Coal (BARC.NS) jumped 6.6% after the company hiked basic prices of certain grades of raw coking coal for the non-regulated sector. Zydus Lifesciences (ZYDU.NS) lost 1.5% after US drug regulator concluded an inspection at the pharmaceutical company's manufacturing plant in Ahmedabad with five observations.

item.dc:creator: ロイター

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 財務省の三村淳財務官は１４日、東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）諸国はエネルギーショックやインフレなど差し迫った課題に対処すべきだと述べた。

バンコクで開かれている国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で、財政支援はＡＳＥＡＮだけでなく日本でも実施されるべきだとした上で、対象を絞り、状況に応じた一時的なものであるべきだと述べた。

item.title: ロシアの日本人拘束、状況明らかになればさらなる申し入れ＝官房長官
item.description:
Shiho Tanaka
[東京 １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Shiho Tanaka

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は１４日午前の会見で、ロシア当局が北海道新聞の日本人記者を拘束したと発表したことを受け、情報提供や人道的な配慮を求める申し入れを行ったと説明した。今後状況が明らかになっていく中で「ロシア側へのさらなる申し入れなど、必要な対応をとる」という。

ロシア連邦保安局（ＦＳＢ）は１３日、北海道新聞の日本人記者をスパイ容疑で拘束したと発表した。具体的な拘束日は明らかにしていない。

木原官房長官によると、ロシア側の発表で日本人が拘束されたことを知り、現在は事実関係などを確認中。在ロシア大使館や総領事館を通じて情報提供を求め、人道的な配慮や公正公平な取り扱いについての申し入れを行ってきているという。拘束された記者とは現時点では接触できておらず、健康状態などは確認できていない。

木原官房長官は「今後状況を明らかにしていく中で、ロシア側へのさらなる申し入れなどの必要な対応をとり、引き続き邦人保護に万全を期していく」と述べた。

日ロ関係を現状、どう認識しているかとの質問に対しては「多くの問題があることは事実」とした上で、隣国でもあり問題の解決のためには意思疎通が必要だと指摘。「関係の適切な維持は重要であるという観点から、何が日本の国益にとって必要であるかということを総合的に勘案しながら、適宜適切に対応していく」と語った。

item.title: Six deaths confirmed in Florida from Hurricane Isaias, governor says
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said on Tuesday six people had been confirmed dead in the state from Hurricane Isaias, which made landfall last week.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said on Tuesday six people had been confirmed dead in the state from [USN:L6N45W00A TEXT:"Hurricane Isaias"], which made landfall last week. "We have now had six storm-related fatalities," DeSantis told reporters The six deaths included two that had been previously confirmed. Those two deaths were in Escambia County in the state's far west. One person died when a tree fell on their home while the other died from carbon monoxide exposure caused by a generator operating inside their garage, officials said DeSantis said the four newly confirmed deaths included a car crash at an intersection where the traffic signal was not working and storm-related disruptions to the medical treatment of two people Hurricane Isaias made landfall early on Saturday and left hundreds of thousands of residents in Florida, Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi without power Alabama Governor Kay Ivey said on Saturday that two people had died as a result of the storm in her state

item.title: Alexis Lafreniere scores twice, Rangers beat Lightning to stay unbeaten at home
item.description: Alexis Lafreniere scored twice in the first period to continue his hot start as the New York Rangers remained unbeaten on home ice with a 4-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Alexis Lafreniere scored twice in the first period to continue his hot start as the New York Rangers remained unbeaten on home ice with a 4-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Tuesday night. Tye Kartye set up both Lafreniere goals after scoring twice in Sunday's 6-2 rout of the Vancouver Canucks. Mika Zibanejad also scored unassisted on a short-handed, empty-net goal with 2:44 remaining during the final seconds of Tampa Bay's 6-on-4 power play. Lafreniere scored his sixth and seventh goals in the opening 12:47 as the Rangers improved to 5-0-0 at home. It is New York's best start on home ice since opening the 1990-91 season with eight straight victories and third time in team history that the Rangers won their first five home games. Lafreniere also scored for a career-high fourth straight game and notched his 12th career multi-goal game to continue his strong start after getting his seventh goal in his 31st game last season. Will Cuylle scored late in the second period for the Rangers, who won for the sixth time in eight games and beat Tampa Bay for the second time after pulling away for a 5-1 victory over the visiting Lightning on Oct. 1. Dylan Garand made 25 saves in New York's second game since losing star goalie Igor Shesterkin to a season-ending lower-body injury. He improved his career record to 5-1-1 and highlighted the win with a point-blank glove save on John Carlson with 8:16 remaining. Garand also made a pad save on Brayden Point's backhand try with about 5 1/2 minutes left and another stop on Nikita Kucherov with 3 1/2 minutes left during Tampa Bay's 6-on-4 power play. Zemgus Girgensons scored late in the opening period for the Lightning, whose four-game winning streak was stopped. Tampa Bay goalie Andrei Vasilevskiy made 19 saves. Lafreniere opened the scoring 62 seconds into the contest when he went to the front of the net, withstood a scramble, took a pass from Kartye and chipped the puck into the net. He scored shortly after Kartye knocked Tampa Bay defenseman Victor Hedman off the puck in the right corner. Lafreniere made it 2-0 at 12:47 by fending off Anthony Cirelli and finishing off a breakaway when Kartye made a long backhand pass while clearing the defensive zone. Girgensons put a shot by Garand from the left circle with 2:34 left in the opening period. Cuylle re-directed a shot from Sean Durzi past Vasilevskiy with 94 seconds left in the second period. --Field Level Media

item.title: イエメン第3の都市タイズ、フーシ派と政府軍の衝突で物価が高騰
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１３日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の戦闘員に包囲されたタイズの住民は、砲撃が激化し、物資が少なくなっていると訴えている。

イエメン第３の都市であるタイズは、米イラン対立をきっかけに紛争が先月再燃して以来、フーシ派とサウジアラビアが支援する政府軍の衝突の主要な戦場となっている。

フーシ派は先週、タイズからアデンへと続く主要道路を遮断し、政府軍を包囲状態に追い込んだ。

国際移住機関（ＩＯＭ）は、タイズの状況がここ数日で著しく悪化しており、人々や生活必需品、人道支援物資が市内に入ることができず、物価が高騰していると述べた。

イエメン政府は先週、フーシ派が支配する地域を奪還するための作戦を開始。世界の海上交通の要衝であるバベルマンデブ海峡付近の地域を奪還した。

しかし、軍事筋によると、フーシ派はタイズ近郊で攻勢を続け、１２日には同市の南約２５キロに位置するムディリヤット・アル・ミスラク町を制圧した。

住民によると、１２日夜にはタイズで激しい砲撃があった。

政府筋は、その責任はフーシ派にあると述べた。

フーシ派の報道官はコメント要請に応じていない。

電話取材に応じた住民のアフマド・マフムード氏は「絶え間ない砲撃のため、恐怖の夜を過ごした。今朝は静けさと不安が漂っている。通りは人影がない」と話した。

電話で取材に応じた別のタイズ住民、ヤシン・ムクビル氏は、広範囲にわたる砲撃があり、自分の子どもは怖がって外に出られないと語った。

ＩＯＭによると、タイズの人口は推定約６０万人。政府筋によると、今回の戦闘で８万人が避難した。

item.title: 韓国現代自、32年までにインドへ155億ドル投資 世界生産拠点に
item.description:
Surbhi Misra Nishit Navin
[１３日 ロイター] - 韓国自動車大手の現代自動車グループは１３...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
韓国現代自、32年までにインドへ155億ドル投資　世界生産拠点に 11:17 配信

２０２５年１月、インドのニューデリーで撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Priyanshu Singh）

Surbhi Misra　Nishit Navin

[１３日 ロイター] - 韓国自動車大手の現代自動車グループは１３日、２０３２年までにインドへ１５５億ドルを投資すると発表した。世界第３位の自動車市場である同国を将来の成長の主要な原動力としてさらに重視する。

この７カ年計画には、インドの研究開発センターへの約７億ドルの投資、生産能力の拡大、および投資統括法人の設立が含まれる。

インドは高まる需要を取り込み、現地の生産能力拡大を図る世界の自動車メーカーから数十億ドル規模の投資を集め、主要な自動車生産拠点としての地位を際立たせている。

現代自動車は昨年、インドにおける製造および研究開発事業の拡大に向けて５０億ドルを投資すると発表していた。

インドで２万４０００人超を雇用する現代自動車は、今回の投資によって製造、研究、エンジニアリング、サプライチェーン（供給網）の各分野で新たに雇用が創出されるとしたが、具体的な人数は明らかにしていない。

同社によると、今回の投資で現地法人のヒュンダイ・モーター・インディアとキア・インディアの生産能力が拡大され、大幅な販売台数の増加を支えられる見通し。

インド自動車最大手マルチ・スズキの筆頭株主であるスズキ自動車 も、２５年に同国へ約８０億ドルを投資する計画を明らかにした。トヨタ自動車やホンダなどの自動車メーカーもインドでの製造事業拡大に取り組むことを表明している。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ネパール土石流でインド人多数が行方不明、ヒンドゥー教聖地巡礼者ら 焦点：インドで強まるＺ世代の影響力、変化迫られるモディ首相 アングル：インド「ゴキブリ人民党」運動がＺ世代に爆発的人気、政権の安定イメージに揺らぎ アングル：印のガス不足、米加州のガソリン価格に波及　石油供給混乱の影響深刻化 アングル：米ではインフレ、印では工場閉鎖　エネルギーショックで世界景気後退も 最終更新: 10/14(水) 11:17 ロイター

item.title: Vietnam says trade talks with US nearly completed; US officials more cautious
item.description: Vietnam and the US have nearly completed negotiations covering a trade deal, Vietnamese Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc said on Wednesday at an event in Hanoi, though US officials appeared more cautious.
item.dc:creator: Khanh Vu, Francesco Guarascio
item.content:encoded: Vietnam and the US have nearly completed negotiations covering a trade deal, Vietnamese Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc said on Wednesday at an event in Hanoi, though US officials appeared more cautious. Export-reliant Vietnam has been in talks for more than a year with the US, its main foreign market, to avoid punitive tariffs. Trump administration officials have repeatedly accused the country of being used as a transit point to lower duties on Chinese goods bound for the US. Vietnam has sent the final text of the agreement to the US, Tuc said at a business forum in Hanoi. "We expect the US to continue to create favorable conditions for Vietnamese goods to access the US market in a stable and sustainable manner," Tuc said. After the US' global tariffs were struck down by the Supreme Court in February, the Trump administration launched three investigations into Vietnam's trade practices. One covering alleged failures to prevent the use of goods made with forced labour ended with 12.5% tariffs on Vietnamese products, higher than most of its regional peers. The other two investigations covering industrial overcapacity and the protection of intellectual property rights are underway and could result in additional tariffs. Tuc said Vietnam expects the US to make objective and balanced assessments in these investigations. Top Vietnamese leader To Lam has been invited by the US to attend the G20 summit in Florida in December, Vietnamese state media reported, raising hopes that a deal could be sealed then. US CAUTIOUS David Fogel, the US assistant secretary of commerce, in a recorded message streamed at the event, said he was “hopeful” the two countries would continue to work together on a trade agreement. He warned that the US' deficit with Vietnam was the largest that the US has with any partner. Vietnam's trade surplus with the US exceeded $163 billion in the January-to-August period, greater than the US' bigger trading partners like Mexico and China, according to the latest US trade data. Among options to balance trade flows, Fogel urged Vietnamese businesses to invest more in the US and noted the US could export "world-class super-intelligence hardware" to Vietnam. The country currently faces restrictions over its access to the US' most advanced technologies. Jennifer Wicks, the US ambassador to Vietnam, reiterated at the event that talks on a trade deal were ongoing. She urged Vietnam to adapt its regulatory framework on data protection to attract investment and allow businesses to deploy new technologies efficiently. US tech companies have [USN:L6N3MA013 TEXT:"repeatedly warned"] that Vietnam’s strict limits on cross-border data transfers discourage investment in the country. Wicks also urged Vietnam to develop predictable policies and stable rules on pricing to favour foreign investment in its expanding energy sector. Vietnam has been negotiating for years with potential foreign investors on prices that it would pay for electricity generated by power plants. It has also retroactively cut price subsidies for some investors in renewables.

item.title: 中国9月ＰＰＩ、4年強ぶりの高い伸び ＣＰＩ上昇率は予想下回る
item.description:
Qiaoyi Li Liz Lee
[北京 １４日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が１４日発表した９月の物価統計は、生...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国9月ＰＰＩ、4年強ぶりの高い伸び　ＣＰＩ上昇率は予想下回る 11:14 配信

２０２５年４月、中国江蘇省宿遷市で撮影（２０２６年　China Daily via REUTERS）

Qiaoyi Li　Liz Lee

[北京 １４日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が１４日発表した９月の物価統計は、生産者物価指数（ＰＰＩ）の伸びが加速し、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の上昇率も小幅に拡大した。原油やコモディティー（商品）価格の高騰で、上流部門の物価上昇圧力が強まった。

ＰＰＩは前年同月比５．０％上昇し、８月の３．８％から伸びが加速。ロイターがまとめた市場予想（４．５％上昇）も上回った。上昇率は２０２２年６月以来の大きさ。

輸送の混乱、悪天候、地政学的緊張に起因する原油や商品価格の高騰が製造業者のコスト圧力を強めているが、需要の低迷により、消費者へのコスト転嫁は限定的となっている。

ＣＰＩは前年同月比０．９％上昇。８月の０．８％から伸びが拡大したが、市場予想（１．０％上昇）は下回った。

製造業者の価格上昇が加速していることを示唆しているが、消費者需要の低迷が引き続きインフレを抑制しており、中国が依然として消費よりも輸出にけん引される不均衡な回復局面にあるという懸念を強めそうだ。

前月比ではＣＰＩが０．２％上昇。市場予想は０．３％上昇、８月は０．４％上昇だった。

統計局によると、ガソリン価格は前年比で１６．６％急騰し、総合ＣＰＩの上昇率に約０．４７ポイント寄与した。しかし、基調的な物価上昇圧力は依然として抑制されており、家計が依然として支出に慎重な姿勢を示していることを示唆している。

変動の激しい食品・エネルギー価格を除いたコアインフレ率は、前年比で１％上昇し、伸び率は８月と変わらなかった。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの中国担当エコノミスト、グエン・ホアン・ナム氏は「上昇圧力の多くは依然として中東紛争による商品供給の混乱に起因しており、特に燃料精製、化学製品、非鉄金属の価格上昇が顕著だった」と述べ、来年には価格が下落に転じると予想している。

国泰君安国際のチーフエコノミスト、周浩氏は、主な問題は製造業のモメンタムの強まりが雇用、所得の伸び、そして消費者信頼感に徐々に波及していくかどうかだと指摘。「その伝達メカニズムが改善すれば、需要面から生産者物価と消費者物価の間の現在の乖離が縮小し、２７年にはより均衡のとれた持続的な回復がもたらされるだろう」と語った。

item.title: ＡＩの学習データ厳格化、経済効果が年1550億ユーロ減少も＝独ＩＦＯ
item.description:
Cian Muenster Leo Marchandon
[１３日 ロイター] - ドイツＩＦＯ経済研究所は１３日、ド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩの学習データ厳格化、経済効果が年1550億ユーロ減少も＝独ＩＦＯ 11:11 配信

AIのイメージ写真。2023年6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Cian Muenster　Leo Marchandon

[１３日 ロイター] - ドイツＩＦＯ経済研究所は１３日、ドイツが人工知能（ＡＩ）の学習データへのアクセス制限を厳格化すれば、経済効果が年間１５５０億ユーロ（約１７３４億３０００万ドル）減るリスクがあるとの試算を発表した。

欧州は最先端ＡＩモデルの開発で米国や中国に追い付こうと急ピッチで取り組んでいる。その中で政策立案者やハイテク企業は、ＡＩがもたらすリスクとイノベーション（技術革新）の促進との間でバランスを取ろうと苦心している。

ＩＦＯエコノミストのオリバー・ファルク氏は「欧州で最先端のＡＩモデルを確立したいと考えるのならば、学習データへのアクセスを不必要に複雑化してはならない。両立は不可能だ」との見解を示した。

ＩＦＯは生成ＡＩモデルが２０３４年までにドイツ経済に年間４４００億ユーロの経済効果をもたらす可能性があると試算。一方、学習データへのアクセスを制限することでＡＩの導入が遅れれば年間４５０億ユーロ、ＡＩモデルの性能が低下すれば年間７５０億ユーロ、研究成果が低減すれば年間２５０億ユーロ、欧州でＡＩ開発が縮小すれば年間１００億ユーロそれぞれ減るリスクがあるとし、これらの合算が年間１５５０億ユーロとなる。

ＩＦＯは欧州連合（ＥＵ）の政策立案者に対し、商業利用に関するＥＵの「テキスト・データマイニング」の適用除外措置を維持しつつ、適切な透明性要件と実用的なオプトアウト基準を設定するよう求めた。欧州については規制の不確実性が欧州への投資を既に阻害していると批判した。

ドイツのＡＩ企業アレフ・アルファのイルハン・シェーア最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はロイターに対して「競争力のあるＡＩの開発には多様で、質の高い学習データへのアクセスが不可欠だ。不必要な規制や法的な不確実性は、その開発を困難にする」と指摘。「欧州は既存の法的枠組みを最大限に活用すべきだ」と訴えた。

item.description:

[ロンドン １３日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は１３日、金...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＬＳＥＧ、金融データ会社オクタス買収に向け協議　約35億ドル 11:11 配信

ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）のロゴ。9月8日、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Toby Melville

Amy-Jo Crowley

[ロンドン １３日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は１３日、金融データ会社オクタスを約３５億ドルで買収する方向で、同社を保有する未公開株式投資会社（プライベートエクイティ）パーミラと交渉していることを認めた。

ＬＳＥＧによると、最終合意には至っておらず、取引の成立は保証されていない。オクタスは、顧客維持率の高いサブスクリプション（定額課金）モデルを基盤に２桁の増収率を維持してきた実績があるという。

ＬＳＥＧは、オクタスの買収がデータ・アナリティクス部門およびグループ全体の増収率に直ちに寄与するとの見方を示した。

ニューヨークに本社を置くオクタスは、最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）のケント・コリアー氏が２０１３年に創業。ジャーナリストやアナリスト、法律専門家を雇用し、経営不振企業を中心とする信用市場の情報を銀行や投資家向けに提供している。

関係筋によると、パーミラはオクタスへの関心を探るため、アドバイザーと連携している。関係者の１人は、パーミラは昨年からオクタス売却を計画、他の買い手候補とも交渉してきたと述べた。パーミラはコメントを拒否している。

item.description: 原油先物上昇、サウジ供給リスク警戒 ロシア軽油輸出も注視 Reuters

item.title: 原油先物上昇、サウジ供給リスク警戒 ロシア軽油輸出も注視
item.description:
Yuka Obayashi
[東京 １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yuka Obayashi

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - １４日アジア時間の原油先物価格は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジアラビアの戦闘による供給リスクを背景に上昇。一方、ロシアの軽油輸出が増加する可能性も意識された。

００３０ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前９時３０分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は０．８９ドル（０．８％）高の１バレル＝１０６．５８ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物は０．８０ドル（０．９％）高の９４．９４ドル。１３日はブレントが０．９％下落する一方、ＷＴＩは０．４％上昇した。

日産証券インベストメントの菊川弘之チーフストラテジストは、フーシ派とサウジの紛争に伴う供給懸念が価格を押し上げていると指摘。ただ、ロシアの軽油輸出増加が需給逼迫を緩和するとの見方から、いずれの方向にも大幅な値動きは抑制される可能性が高いとし、ＷＴＩは９０─１００ドルで推移すると予想した。

サウジアラビアのエネルギー省は１４日、東部ダーランにある国有石油会社サウジアラムコ2222.SEの管理棟が１３日夜に攻撃を受け、小規模な火災が発生したと発表した。

item.title: ロシアに人道的配慮・公正公平な取り扱い要求＝日本人記者拘束で茂木外相
item.description: ［東京 １４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［東京　１４日　ロイター］ - 茂木敏充外相は１４日の衆院予算委員会で、ロシア連邦保安局（ＦＳＢ）が北海道新聞の日本人記者を拘束したと発表したことを受けて、在ロシア日本大使館などを通じてロシア側に情報提供や事実関係の確認を求めるとともに、人道的配慮、公正公平な取り扱いを申し入れていると明らかにした。田中健委員（国民）への答弁。

中国黒竜江省の視察団による択捉島訪問については、北方領土があたかもロシア領であるかのような第三国からの入域や活動は決して受け入れることができないとコメントした。

item.title: ＡＩ投資が金融環境引き締めも、ＥＣＢ政策判断に影響＝レーン専務理事
item.description: [フランクフルト １３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるレーン専務理事は１３日、ユーロ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ投資が金融環境引き締めも、ＥＣＢ政策判断に影響＝レーン専務理事 11:07 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるレーン専務理事。2024年6月、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Anna Gordon

[フランクフルト １３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるレーン専務理事は１３日、ユーロ圏企業による人工知能（ＡＩ）の利用拡大が労働者の賃上げ交渉力を抑制する可能性があるとの見解を示した。また、ＡＩへの巨額投資が金融環境を大幅に引き締めている可能性も指摘した。

エネルギー価格高を背景にインフレ率がＥＣＢの目標の２％のほぼ２倍に達する中、政策当局者は物価上昇の２次的影響の兆候を探っている。ただ、これまでのところ、特に賃金の伸びにはそうした兆候が見られないと判断している。

レーン氏は、ＡＩは雇用動向を変えていないものの、企業の採用計画は低調で、高インフレを補う賃上げを求める労働者の交渉力が制限されていると説明。高インフレにもかかわらず賃金の伸びが鈍化している理由として、一つの可能性を示した。

ダブリンでの講演で「ＡＩが一部の職種を代替する可能性も、労働者の交渉力を弱め、賃金の伸びを抑え、総所得に占める労働所得の割合を低下させる恐れがある」と述べた。

現行の金融政策には直接言及しなかったが、世界各地の企業がＡＩ投資の資金を賄うために巨額の借り入れを行っており、それが借り手全般の調達コストを押し上げ、ＥＣＢの政策判断に影響するほど資金調達環境を引き締めていると指摘した。

「ユーロ圏の債券市場への波及は、長期金利の上昇がユーロ圏にとって金融環境の大幅な引き締めとなっていることを意味する」とし、「これはＥＣＢが適切な金融政策スタンスを決定する上で重要な要素だ」と述べた。

ＥＣＢはインフレの定着を防ぐために利上げを進めている。一部のエコノミストは、資金調達環境全般が引き締まれば、物価上昇を抑えるためにＥＣＢが行う引き締めは小幅で済む可能性があると指摘しており、今回の発言は重要な意味を持つ。

レーン氏はまた、ＡＩが長期的に経済に重要な影響を及ぼし、潜在生産量とトレンド成長率を押し上げ、経済の潜在的な「スピードリミット」を引き上げる可能性があるとも述べた。

同氏は「欧州にとって、予想される生産年齢人口の減少傾向がもたらす経済的影響をＡＩが相殺する可能性は、特に価値がある」と語った。

item.title: 両手に刃物を縛り付けたとみられる男、スーパーの客らを次々と切りつけ8人負傷 韓国・仁川
item.description:
韓国北西部の仁川にあるスーパーマーケットで13日、刃物による襲撃事件が発生し、8人が負傷、うち1人が心肺停止状態となった。警察が明らかにした。
警察報道官は電話取材に対し、現場に駆けつけた警察官が男の容疑者を逮捕し、動機や事件の経緯を捜査中だと述べた。
聯合ニュースが伝えた目撃者の話によると、容疑者は両手に刃物を縛り付けた状態で商業施設の複数のフロアを移動しながら人々を襲い、居合わせた客らに取り押さえられた後、警察に引き渡されたという。
韓国メディアの報道によると、容疑者は60代の男で、性犯罪者などの再犯防止に向けた電子監視用の足輪を着用していた。負傷者は女性6人と男性2人で、このうち20代の女性1人が心肺停止状態にあるという。

item.title: アンソロピック幹部、ＡＩ開発で安全策不備なら「ブレーキ強める可能性も」
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック幹部、ＡＩ開発で安全策不備なら「ブレーキ強める可能性も」 11:04 配信

米人工知能（AI）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者で、公共利益部門責任者を務めるジャック・クラーク氏。10月14日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者で、公共利益部門責任者を務めるジャック・クラーク氏が１４日、都内で記者会見し、ＡＩ開発において安全対策が十分でない場合は「より強くブレーキを踏まなければならないかもしれない」と述べ、開発減速の可能性もあり得るとの見方を示した。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はＡＩ開発の減速を訴えている。クラーク氏は、自動車を運転する際にはライトを照らし前方を確認する必要があると例え、ＡＩ開発においてもリスクが見えていなければ自信を持って進むことはできないと指摘した。

不正アクセスによる情報流出などが続発していることについて、サイバー攻撃の詳細は把握してないものの「おそらくＡＩツールが使われている可能性はあると思う」と述べた。ただ、自律型の攻撃が行われた証拠は確認していないとした。

クラーク氏は「ハッカーも企業と同じように、手に入るツールを使う」と指摘。アンソロピックとしてはセキュリティー技術を使い、攻撃者が自社のツールを使えないように取り組んでいるものの「他社のモデルや（利用者がパラメータを変更可能な ）オープンウエートモデルもある」と述べた。

その上で、「世界中でＡＩを安全かつ確実に開発する上では、今後数年間が極めて重要だ」 と述べ、日本のサイバー防衛に貢献する方法の探求も含め、日本とのパートナーシップ構築を図る方針を示した。日本はＡＩサプライチェーン（供給網）、科学的な機器の製造、ロボティクスにおける専門性があるため「有利な立場にある」と指摘。まもなく始まる大きな技術トレンドによって飛躍的に成長する準備が整っていると述べた。

また、世界各地でデータセンターの建設を進めており、日本でも建設できる方法を探っているとした。

クラーク氏は、日本法人の設立１周年に合わせて来日。１３日には古川俊治デジタル相と会談した。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝セルティックス、プリチャードと2年約69.9億円で契約延長へ─報道
item.description: ［１３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のセルティックスが、ガードのペイトン・プリチャード（２８）と２年総額４４２０万ドル（約６９億９０００万円）の契約延長で合意したと、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１３日に報じた。

新契約は２０２８─２９シーズンから始まり、２９─３０シーズンについては双方の合意で行使するオプションが含まれる。現行契約は２７─２８シーズンまでとなっている。

プリチャードは昨季、７９試合出場（先発５０試合）で１試合平均１７．０得点、５．２アシスト、３．９リバウンドと、いずれも自己最高の成績を残した。２４─２５シーズンには最優秀シックスマン賞（最優秀控え選手賞）を受賞している。

２０年のドラフト１巡目（全体２６位）指名でセルティックスに入団し、これまで通算４２６試合出場で１試合平均１０．６得点、３．０アシスト、３．０リバウンドを記録。２４年の優勝にも貢献した。

item.title: IMF dials up calls for urgent fiscal consolidation
item.description: The International Monetary Fund on Wednesday issued an urgent call for advanced economies and others to reduce government spending, cut deficits and lower debt levels, warning that delays would only make the job harder in coming years.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund on Wednesday issued an urgent call for advanced economies and others to reduce government spending, cut deficits and lower debt levels, warning that delays would only make the job harder in coming years. Rodrigo Valdes, head of the IMF's Fiscal Affairs department, said rising sovereign bond yields were adding to fiscal pressures at a time when average public debt was poised to hit 100% of gross domestic product, the highest seen since World War Two, leaving countries with less margin for delay. "We're saying now it's urgent and it's now because basically the conditions have changed," Valdes said, noting the risks posed by inflationary pressures, high levels of global debt and rising sovereign bond yields. "So, if you want one message, we dialed up the urgency of our message." Ahead of this week's annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank in Bangkok, Valdes had told Reuters that "the fiscal results this year are worse than expected six months ago, and worse than they were one year ago." The majority of countries were now looking at boosting spending instead of tightening their belts, he said. NEED TO BUILD POLITICAL SUPPORT Valdes said the challenge for major advanced economies with high debt levels was to build political support for concrete plans to contain borrowing costs in the medium term, and limit spillovers to the rest of the world. "The more countries wait, the more painful the adjustment becomes," the IMF said in a blog released on Wednesday . Delaying adjustments would lead to increasing interest burdens and fiscal vulnerabilities, further narrowing policy options. Financing conditions for many emerging market and developing economies had remained favorable, but might not last, the IMF said, urging those countries to also reduce their fiscal vulnerabilities and strengthen debt management. Low-income countries, where external financing was already tighter, needed to strengthen their tax systems and improve spending efficiency, the IMF said. High oil prices, persistent inflation, stronger investment demand and higher-than-expected AI growth have driven sharp increases in long-term sovereign yields in recent months. The Group of Seven's average 10-year government bond yield rose over 110 basis points between February and September, reaching its highest level in nearly two decades, the IMF said. The IMF said the effective average cost of government financing was projected to rise to 3.7% by 2031 from 2.3% in 2021. In the US, interest payments were expected to reach 5.3% of GDP, up from 2.8% of GDP before the COVID pandemic, roughly equal to its projected expenditure on Social Security. That number was even higher in low-income countries, where interest payments today consume over 15% of tax revenues, compared to an average cost of around 9% between 2011 and 2019. Adding to the stress, governments in advanced economies were refinancing more debt at shorter maturities, causing higher rates to pass through to government costs more quickly, the IMF said. For the G7 and Spain, it said, the share of debt maturing within one year was now approaching 30%. Inflation rates above target and higher energy prices meant central bankers would likely need to keep rates higher for longer, which in turn would limit governments' ability to respond to downturns, just as demands for increased spending on defense, energy security and aging populations were mounting. The IMF said interest rates on debt also now exceeded expected nominal growth rates in a number of countries, which would make it even harder for them to stabilize debt. Valdes said more countries were allowing higher energy prices to pass through, but many were still relying on costly, broad-based measures to shield their populations. "Our estimate is that taken together, the fiscal cost of all these measures is about one half percent of global GDP (gross domestic product)," he said, noting that a continuation of such measures would drive prices higher at the global level.

item.title: ＢｏｆＡで幹部流出続く、経営陣は社内の動揺抑制に注力＝関係筋
item.description:
Svea Herbst-Bayliss Saeed Azhar Milana Vinn
[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイタ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＢｏｆＡで幹部流出続く、経営陣は社内の動揺抑制に注力＝関係筋 11:01 配信

写真は米金融大手バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）の支店。9月1日、米ニューヨーク市で撮影。 REUTERS/Jordan Tovin

Svea Herbst-Bayliss　Saeed Azhar　Milana Vinn

[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米金融大手バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）の上層部は８月の第１週、同社で最も上級の女性幹部の１人であるベテランのエイミー・リサウアー氏が競合のＪＰモルガン・チェースへの移籍を検討しているという問題に直面していた。複数の関係筋によると、残留の説得は実を結ばず、過去１年間に他の著名なディールメーカー数人が相次いで去ったことに続く同氏の退社は従業員に大きな動揺を与え、経営陣は対応を迫られる事態となった。

ＢｏｆＡにとって、経営や戦略の抜本的な見直しを求めるアクティビスト（物言う株主）から法人顧客を守るリーダーとして認められていたリサウアー氏の引き留めは優先事項だったが、関係筋によると、ＪＰモルガンから提示された条件はＢｏｆＡが太刀打ちできないものだった。

ウォール街（米金融業界）では幹部の入れ替わりは日常茶飯事であり、銀行がベテランのディールメーカーを失うことも珍しくない。しかし、こうした幹部の流出を受け、ＢｏｆＡの経営陣は波及効果を抑えようと従業員に働きかけた。

８月１０日には従業員を安心させようと会議を開き、関係筋によると、幹部らはＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）の「リーグテーブル」での順位向上に全力を尽くすと約束。ある参加者は、ＢｏｆＡがリーグテーブルのトップを目指しており、特にテクノロジー分野に重点を置いてシニアバンカーの採用を拡大していると述べたという。

関係筋によると、資本市場が好況にある中で、収益源となる上級幹部が相次いで退社すれば、従業員の士気が低下し、全米第２位の銀行が投資銀行業務において競合他社に後れを取っているという認識を強めてしまうのではないかという経営陣の懸念が浮き彫りになった。

ＢｏｆＡの広報担当者はロイターに宛てた声明で「当社はグローバル事業全体で強力な勢いを維持しており、業界を特徴づける数多くの取引において、主要アドバイザーとして顧客を代表している」と説明。「今年、主要な競合他社から数十人のシニアバンカーを採用したが、これは当社のプラットフォームの強さと、米国および世界中の顧客にサービスを提供するソリューションの幅広さを反映している」と述べた。

item.title: 台湾がアラスカＬＮＧ30％購入に合意、トランプ氏表明
item.description:
Gram Slattery Bo Erickson
[ワシラ（米アラスカ州） １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Bo Erickson

[ワシラ（米アラスカ州） １３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１３日、アラスカ州で開催された集会で、台湾が同州のパイプラインプロジェクトから生産される液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の３０％を購入することに合意したと述べた。取引の条件については明らかになっていない。

集会に参加したラトニック米商務長官は、台湾が同パイプラインの開発に４４億ドルを投資することを約束したと述べた。

台湾経済部（経済省）は今のところコメントを出していない。

台湾の卓栄泰行政院長（首相）はトランプ氏の発言について記者団に問われ、台湾当局の役割は「他国の政府と同様、エネルギー供給全体を安定させ、強靱性を高めることだ」と述べた。

台湾当局者は２月、２０２６年の天然ガス輸入量に占める米国産の割合を約３分の１に引き上げ、他国からの購入を減らす方針を示していた。

台湾の石油元売り最大手の公営企業である台湾中油（ＣＰＣ）は昨年、アラスカ・ガスライン・デベロップメントと、ＬＮＧの購入およびパイプラインプロジェクトへの投資に関する協定を締結した。

台湾の頼清徳総統は当時、この投資が台湾のエネルギー安全保障を確保するものだと述べていた。

トランプ氏の発言からは、最終合意が結ばれたかどうかは明らかでない。

台湾総統府の潘孟安秘書長は昨年、アラスカのＬＮＧプロジェクト予定地を視察した。トランプ政権は同プロジェクトを供給源の選択肢としてアジアの同盟国に強く売り込んでいる。

建設されれば、アラスカＬＮＧプロジェクトは年間最大２０００万トンのＬＮＧを輸出することになる。

item.title: SK Group Chairman Chey sells stake to Dell family office fund for $406 million
item.description: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won has agreed the sale of a 1.34% stake in holding company SK Inc to an investment fund linked to Dell Technologies founder Michael Dell for 544 billion won ($406 million), a regulatory filing showed on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won has agreed the sale of a 1.34% stake in holding company SK Inc (034730.KS) to an investment fund linked to Dell Technologies (DELL.N) founder Michael Dell for 544 billion won ($406 million), a regulatory filing showed on Wednesday. The deal is part of Chey's plan to raise 944 billion won through share sales to pay a divorce settlement to his former wife. Here are some details: The buyer of 972,493 SK Inc shares was identified as DFO Public Investments, L.P., a Delaware-based investment fund affiliated with DFO Management, the family investment office of Michael Dell, according to the filing and DFO Management's website. Earlier this month, SK Inc said in a filing that Chey had agreed to [USN:L1N45O06F TEXT:"sell 1.65 million shares, or a 2.26% stake"] for 944 billion won. Of those, 681,431 shares, or 0.94%, will be sold to Korea Investment & Securities for 400 billion won. SK had previously identified the buyer of the remaining shares only as a strategic investor, saying the investor had agreed to buy the stake after considering SK Inc's business competitiveness and medium- to long-term growth prospects. Dell Technologies, a major supplier of AI servers and data centre infrastructure, has business ties with SK Hynix (000660.KS) , SK Group's memory chipmaking unit. The stake is being acquired by a Dell family investment fund, rather than Dell Technologies itself. Reuters reported in May that global technology companies had approached SK Hynix with [USN:L4N41K05W TEXT:"proposals"] to invest in dedicated memory chip production lines and help finance costly manufacturing equipment as they sought to secure supplies amid booming AI demand. The Korea Corporate Governance Forum said Chey and the buyers would be required to disclose their stakes as joint holdings if they had agreed, even informally, to exercise their voting rights in the same way. Failure to do so would violate South Korea's capital markets law, it said. The forum, an independent watchdog that monitors corporate governance issues in South Korea, said a strategic investor suggested their interests could be aligned, raising the possibility that the fund could be deemed a joint holder with Chey under the law. ($1 = 1,339.6000 won)

item.title: Andrei Svechnikov, Canes take down Caps for sixth straight win
item.description: Andrei Svechnikov's second goal of the game lifted the Carolina Hurricanes to their sixth consecutive victory by beating the Washington Capitals 4-2 on Tuesday night in Raleigh, N.C.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Andrei Svechnikov's second goal of the game lifted the Carolina Hurricanes to their sixth consecutive victory by beating the Washington Capitals 4-2 on Tuesday night in Raleigh, N.C. Svechnikov, who also had an assist, gave the Hurricanes their first lead with 6:04 remaining with a power-play tally. Carolina had been 0-for-4 on power plays until that sequence. Eric Robinson and Mark Jankowski, whose empty-net goal came with 1:27 remaining, also scored for the Hurricanes, who avenged a 5-2 loss to the Capitals in the same arena less than two weeks earlier. Sebastian Aho posted two assists. Pyotr Kochetkov made 20 saves. Boone Jenner and Justin Holl had Washington's goals, and Ryan Leonard provided two assists. Logan Thompson stopped 31 shots, but the Capitals lost their second straight game. Svechnikov has compiled six goals and five assists in the season's first eight games. The Hurricanes revealed earlier in the day that captain Jordan Staal will miss at least a month with a calf injury. Jenner opened the scoring with the only first-period goal. Svechnikov put Carolina on the board 3:58 into the second period. Holl and Robinson scored later in the period for a 2-2 tie. Jankowski's goal enabled him to extend the best opening stretch of his career with his fifth goal this month. Hurricanes forward Taylor Hall played less than 4 1/2 minutes as he exited with an upper-body injury, according to TSN.ca. It was the beginning of Capitals star Alex Ovechkin's farewell tour since he announced last week this would be his final season. This marked the final regular-season game in Raleigh for the Capitals, who selected the winger in the 2004 NHL Draft that was held in the same building where Tuesday night's game was played. Ovechkin had two shots on goal in 13 minutes of ice time. Washington didn't convert on its two power plays. --Field Level Media

item.title: Asia shares edge up as chip selloff eases; US CPI awaited
item.description: Asian shares inched higher on Wednesday as those related to artificial intelligence found respite after a selloff, while any gain was tempered by elevated oil prices and caution ahead of U.S. inflation data later in the global day.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: Asian shares inched higher on Wednesday as those related to artificial intelligence found respite after a selloff, while any gain was tempered by elevated oil prices and caution ahead of U.S. inflation data later in the global day. Among firms in the AI supply chain, chipmakers Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) rose more than 2% in South Korea while Kioxia (285A.T) was steady in Japan, recovering some of the [USN:L6N45Z12J TEXT:"previous session's loss"]. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) was up 0.5% after U.S. stocks ended the previous session with a mild loss. Japan's Nikkei (.N225) rose 0.2% and South Korea's Kospi (.KS11) added 1.8%. Sentiment remained cautious, however, with oil prices elevated as concern over energy supplies intensified following Houthi missile and drone attacks on [USN:L1N45Z0HH TEXT:"Saudi Arabia"]. U.S. crude ticked up 0.8% to $94.96 a barrel. Brent crude rose to $106.6. "After yesterday's chip-led sell-off in the region ... market participants will be gauging whether shakiness across major indices eases. The geopolitical situation globally and the impact on energy markets won't help," said analyst Kyle Rodda at Capital.com. In another sign of risk aversion, longer-dated bonds rallied as investors sought safety. The yield on benchmark 10-year Treasury notes was steady at 5.221% after touching its lowest in nearly two weeks, while that on 30-year notes held at 5.569% following a three-day decline. On Wall Street overnight, U.S. bank stocks lost ground after [USN:L1N45Z0O3 TEXT:"mixed quarterly earnings results"] from Citigroup (C.N) and peers, weighing on broader markets. U.S. stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis , were up 0.04% at 7,858.8. CPI TEST AWAITED Market participants were awaiting US consumer price index data (USCPF=ECI) on Wednesday, hoping to extract clues on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate outlook. On average, economists estimated headline inflation accelerated to an annual 3.6% in September due to rebounding energy prices, with the core CPI rising 0.2% on a monthly basis. "The risk is the core CPI surprises to the upside because of strong consumer demand and higher costs, pushing up market pricing of an October Fed hike and the USD," said currency strategist Carol Kong at Commonwealth Bank of Australia. Investors priced in a 22% chance of an October interest rate hike ahead of the CPI data, the CME FedWatch Tool showed. New York Federal Reserve President John Williams [USN:L6N45Z14X TEXT:"said"] the Fed may need to raise its policy rate once more this year to slow inflation, but that he sees no need for hikes in 2027. The dollar index , which tracks the greenback against the currencies of some major trading partners, was down at 102.17. The euro was little changed at $1.1202. Market participants were also awaiting Chinese inflation data on Wednesday, looking for signs of reviving domestic demand amid deflationary pressure.

item.title: Canadiens relinquish two-goal lead, sink Sabres in shootout
item.description: Cole Caufield and Lane Hutson each had a goal and an assist and the Montreal Canadiens recovered for a 4-3 shootout win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Cole Caufield and Lane Hutson each had a goal and an assist and the Montreal Canadiens recovered for a 4-3 shootout win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Tuesday. Alexandre Texier scored the deciding goal in the shootout, Juraj Slafkovsky had two assists and Jacob Fowler made 14 saves for the Canadiens, who have won two straight games via the shootout. Olen Zellweger scored twice and Mattias Samuelsson and Beck Malenstyn each had two assists for the Sabres, who have lost three of their last four. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 35 saves. Trailing 3-1, Buffalo scored twice in the span of a minute early in the third period to tie it. Josh Norris pulled his team within one at 4:24, firing a shot from the middle of the blue line that went off Montreal defenseman Adam Engstrom past Fowler on the glove side. Zellweger's second of the night tied it 3-3 at 5:25, taking a pass from Zach Benson at the left point and sending through traffic to beat Fowler blocker side. After the scoreless overtime period, Caufield, Texier and Zachary Bolduc scored for the Canadiens in the shootout, while Tage Thompson found the net for the Sabres. Zellweger gave Buffalo a 1-0 lead at 2:16 of the first period. He took a feed from Samuelsson at the left point and fired a snap shot through traffic that deflected off Engstrom's and redirected past Fowler. Hutson capitalized in the final seconds of a 5-on-3 power play to tie it. Slafkovsky returned a pass to Hutson, who then snapped it from above the right circle to beat a screened Luukkonen at 14:28, with eight seconds remaining in the two-man advantage. Caufield put the hosts ahead 2-1 off the rush at 1:19 of the second period. Slafkovsky took a short drop pass from Nick Suzuki along the right side and dished it to Caufield in the left circle, where he quickly fired it past Luukkonen's right arm. The Canadiens took advantage of the Sabres' inability to clear the zone to make it 3-1. Hutson intercepted a rim up the wall by the visitors, passed it to Bolduc who returned it to him, and Hutson fed Josh Anderson for a one-timer that went bar down on Luukkonen at 19:10 of the second period. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝バルセロナが大勝、アトレチコはマンＵに完勝 欧州ＣＬ
item.description: ［マドリード １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マドリード　１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）は１３日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、バルセロナ（スペイン）がガラタサライ（トルコ）に４─１の大勝を飾った。

バルセロナは敵地で前半２８分に失点するも、４３分にジョアン・カンセロが決めて前半のうちに追い付くと、後半５分にラミン・ヤマルのアシストからフェルミン・ロペスが加点。その３分後には再びヤマルのお膳立てからアンソニー・ゴードンが得点を奪い、最後はカリム・アデイェミのゴールで締めくくった。

アトレチコ・マドリード（スペイン）はマンチェスター・ユナイテッド（マンＵ、イングランド）に２─０で完勝した。立ち上がりからわずか５０秒、左サイドを突破したアレックス・バエナのクロスからパブロ・バリオスが先制すると、後半にアデモラ・ルックマンも決めて今大会初勝利となった。

その他、インテル（イタリア）は、ニコロ・トレソルディにハットトリックを決められるなどし、クラブ・ブリュージュ（ベルギー）に３─４で競り負けた。ビリャレアル（スペイン）はナポリ（イタリア）を３─１で下し、スポルティング（ポルトガル）はＲＣランス（フランス）を２─０で退けた。

item.title: Vaticano confirma que el papa León XIV tiene cáncer de pulmón y descarta complicaciones tras cirugía
item.description: El pontífice fue sometido a una intervención en Roma para extirpar el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho. El Vaticano canceló sus audiencias hasta el 20 de octubre, pero mantiene previsto su viaje a A ...
item.dc:creator: Flavia Rotondi, Vernon Silver
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los médicos diagnosticaron al papa León XIV un cáncer de pulmón y le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho durante una intervención quirúrgica, según informó la Santa Sede. La intervención, realizada en el hospital Gemelli de Roma, se llevó a cabo tras el descubrimiento previo de un nódulo en su pulmón. El diagnóstico confirmó las sospechas derivadas de las pruebas preoperatorias, según indicó la Santa Sede en un comunicado. “La intervención fue un éxito y no hubo complicaciones”, señaló. El pontífice, nacido en Estados Unidos y de 71 años, reveló durante su bendición dominical habitual del 11 de octubre que los médicos habían detectado el nódulo pulmonar. Afirmó entonces que se encontraba en una fase localizada y “muy inicial”. El anuncio sorpresa tuvo lugar apenas unas semanas antes de un viaje apostólico previsto a Uruguay, Argentina y Perú, cuyo inicio está programado para el 6 de noviembre. Ver más: Este fue el último parte oficial sobre la salud del papa León XIV tras su operación La intervención duró unos 90 minutos, según informó la Santa Sede en su comunicado. Leo permaneció en el quirófano durante unas tres horas. “Tras la intervención, el Papa recuperó la conciencia con normalidad y, tras un breve periodo de observación, regresó a su habitación”, indicaba el comunicado. Leo, quien lleva un estilo de vida activo que incluye jugar al tenis con regularidad, ingresó el martes por la mañana en el Gemelli, el centro al que suelen ser trasladados los pontífices enfermos para recibir tratamiento. El predecesor de Leo, Francisco, pasó varias semanas en ese mismo centro médico en 2025 para tratarse una infección pulmonar y someterse a una cirugía abdominal. Ver más: Papa León dice que la tecnología debe ayudar a las personas y advierte sobre la “deshumanización” El Vaticano ha cancelado todas las audiencias de Leo hasta el 20 de octubre para darle tiempo a recuperarse, pero el tan esperado viaje a América Latina sigue programado. Leo fue elegido líder de los 1.400 millones de católicos del mundo en mayo de 2025. Ha dejado su huella en el papado al abordar las implicaciones sociales y éticas de la inteligencia artificial. En su primera encíclica a los fieles, publicada en mayo, Leo afirmó que la IA debería ser “desarmada” para proteger a la humanidad de sus peligros. Se ha mostrado cada vez más crítico con las acciones militares de EE.UU., cuestionando el argumento de la administración Trump de que Dios estaba del lado de EE.UU. en su conflicto con Irán. Más recientemente, señaló en X que la pena de muerte debería ser “inadmisible, ya que constituye un ataque a la inviolabilidad y la dignidad de la persona”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: China factory-gate inflation heats up as commodity costs rise, CPI lags forecasts
item.description: China's producer prices rose at their fastest pace in more than four years in September while consumer inflation edged up, as pricier oil and commodities lifted factory-gate costs even as weak domestic demand kept broader price pressures contained.
item.dc:creator: Qiaoyi Li, Liz Lee
item.content:encoded: China's producer prices rose at their fastest pace in more than four years in September while consumer inflation edged up, as pricier oil and commodities lifted factory-gate costs even as weak domestic demand kept broader price pressures contained. The data suggests prices are revving up for manufacturers, but weak consumer demand continues to restrain inflation, reinforcing concerns that China still faces an uneven recovery driven more by exports than spending. Household spending remains subdued and private-sector confidence fragile despite a series of stimulus measures, underscoring persistent weakness in domestic demand and broader economic imbalances. The producer price index rose 5% from a year earlier, National Bureau of Statistics data showed on Wednesday, up from 3.8% in August and beating the estimated 4.5% rise in a Reuters poll. That marks the fastest pace of factory-gate inflation since June 2022. "Much of the upward pressure still came from commodity supply disruptions caused by the Middle East conflict, with prices rising particularly sharply in fuel processing, chemicals and non-ferrous metals," said Nguyen Hoang Nam, China economist at Capital Economics, who expects prices to fall back next year. Higher oil and commodity prices, driven by transport disruptions, adverse weather and geopolitical tensions, have increased cost pressures for manufacturers, though sluggish demand has limited the pass-through to consumers. The consumer price index (CPI) gained 0.9% year-on-year, compared with a 0.8% increase in August, and came in below economists' forecast for a 1% rise. Gasoline prices soared 16.6% from a year earlier and contributed about 0.47 percentage points to headline CPI growth, the statistics agency said. Underlying consumer price pressures, however, remained muted, suggesting households are still cautious about spending. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, was up 1% on the year, unchanged from August. Zhou Hao, chief economist at Guotai Junan International, said a key question is whether stronger industrial momentum can gradually feed into employment, income growth and consumer confidence. "If that transmission mechanism improves, the current divergence between producer and consumer prices could narrow from the demand side, creating a more balanced and durable recovery in 2027." Markets were little changed, with China's blue-chip index (.CSI300) down 0.1% and the Shanghai Composite (.SSEC) up 0.1%. Beijing has stepped up support for the economy, [USN:L6N45V0EV TEXT:"approving"] an additional 550 billion yuan ($82.15 billion) in unused local government bond quota for infrastructure and other spending, adding to [USN:L1N45L0BK TEXT:"measures"] such as mortgage subsidies. Month-on-month, CPI ticked up 0.2%, versus expectations for a 0.3% gain and a 0.4% increase in August. ($1 = 6.6953 Chinese yuan)

item.title: 冷蔵庫の温度が50度に、仏スーパーマーケットにサイバー攻撃 食品廃棄で店長謝罪
item.description:
フランスで多数のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵・冷凍設備を標的にした大規模なサイバー攻撃が行われ、冷蔵庫や冷凍庫の温度が一晩で最高50度まで上昇した。これにより食品の損失や火災が発生し、当局が調査を進めている。
北西部ラ・エーにあるスーパーマーケット「インターマルシェ」の店長は12日、同店の冷蔵設備がサイバー攻撃を受けたことを受け、顧客に謝罪した。 「当店のソフトウエアがサイバー攻撃で、温度が26度まで上昇し、一部の商品が溶けてしまった。本日、生鮮食品と冷凍食品はすべて廃棄となった。 お客様には心よりおわび申し上げます。ラ・エーのような地方の店舗でも、こうした事態が起きるとは思わなかった。生鮮食品はすべて廃棄するため、本日のご来店はお控えください。商品の損失は甚大だ。今朝の時点で地域の6店舗が被害を受けたと聞いている。多くの商品を失い、大変申し訳なく思っている。一日も早く営業を再開し、売り場で皆様をお迎えできるよう努めたい」

item.title: Tkachuk brothers make NHL history as Panthers top Blue Jackets
item.description: Brady Tkachuk recorded a natural hat trick during an 8:03 span of the second period, brother Matthew Tkachuk posted five assists and the visiting Florida Panthers won 7-3 over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brady Tkachuk recorded a natural hat trick during an 8:03 span of the second period, brother Matthew Tkachuk posted five assists and the visiting Florida Panthers won 7-3 over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Tuesday night. Matthew assisted on all three of Brady's goals, making him the first to assist on each of a brother's natural hat trick, according to the NHL. Brady Tkachuk added one assist for four points; the point totals tied a career high for each Tkachuk. Seth Jones had four assists, Carter Verhaeghe scored twice and Sam Reinhart posted two goals with a helper for Florida, which went 4-for-6 on the power play. With Jacob Markstrom day-to-day due to tightness, Florida's Akira Schmid made 24 saves. Kent Johnson scored early, while Denton Mateychuk and Cole Sillinger each added a late goal for the Blue Jackets. Cam Talbot stopped 17 of 23 shots before being pulled in the third period for Columbus. Johnson opened the scoring with 5:49 remaining in the first period. Off an own-zone Panthers turnover, Johnson possessed the puck, broke free and went low to beat Schmid. Florida, though, tied it 2:27 into the second period, when Matthew Tkachuk slid the puck through the slot for Brady to record his first goal as a Panther. Less than four minutes later, and on the power play, a circle-stationed Matthew sent the puck into the slot for Brady to bury. Tkachuk completed the natural hat trick with 9:30 left in the middle frame. Again on the power play, Brady benefited from a generous bounce off the end-board of Reinhart's shot for a top-shelf conversion. With 6:16 to go in the second, Columbus' Mathieu Olivier was issued a five-minute major penalty and game misconduct for his slash between the legs of Florida's Uvis Balinskis. And, in the waning moments of that extended power play with 2:10 remaining before the second intermission, the Tkachuk brothers set up Verhaeghe's successful net-side one-timer. Matthew Tkachuk's fifth assist came 1:20 into the third, via Reinhart's tip-in, power-play score. Verhaeghe's wrister through traffic with 16:32 remaining in regulation made it 6-1 and ended Talbot's night. Columbus' Jet Greaves stopped all four shots faced in relief. --Field Level Media

item.title: Oil prices climb as Iran deploys new tactics to target ships transiting Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices climbed on Wednesday after two vessels were struck in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian officials told Reuters they were deploying new tactics to target ships, as Tehran seeks to keep oil prices high and influence the US midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Yuka Obayashi, Emily Chow
item.content:encoded: Oil prices climbed on Wednesday after two vessels [USN:L1N45Z0YL TEXT:"were struck"] in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian officials told Reuters they were deploying [USN:L8N45Z15J TEXT:"new tactics"] to target ships, as Tehran seeks to keep oil prices high and influence the US midterm elections. Brent crude futures rose 63 cents, or 0.6%, to $106.32 a barrel by 0345 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures gained 66 cents, or 0.7%, to $94.80 a barrel. Both contracts rose more than $1 in earlier trade before paring some gains. The Iranian officials declined to provide details of the new strategy, but one said that Iran had started using different offensive tactics against vessels it considered in violation of its restrictions about 10 days ago, adding that this had led to an increase in attacks on such ships. A container ship and a tanker were hit by unknown projectiles within the Strait of Hormuz, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations said on Tuesday. "The fact that Iranian officials are openly admitting to undermining US efforts to keep oil prices under control speaks volumes about the real intentions behind the so-called 'peace talks,'" said Priyanka Sachdeva, head of market insights at Phillip Nova. "Iran is well aware of its geographical importance and the havoc higher oil prices can inflict on the global economy, and it may not shy away from using this leverage." Elsewhere, the Iran-allied Houthis [USN:L1N45Z0HH TEXT:"attacked"] an administrative building belonging to state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) in the city of Dhahran, causing a limited fire, Saudi Arabia's energy ministry said on Wednesday. The group has fired ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia over the past week in retaliation for the kingdom's support of Yemeni government forces. Riyadh's [USN:L6N45Y0C1 TEXT:"international airport"] has been hit four times, with a strike on Saturday killing 13 people. "Supply concern stemming from conflict between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is driving prices higher," said Hiroyuki Kikukawa, chief strategist at Nissan Securities Investment, a unit of Nissan Securities. "However, the expectation that increased Russian diesel exports will ease market tightness is likely to limit sharp price movement in either direction," Kikukawa said, projecting WTI to trade between $90 and $100 a barrel. Last month, Saudi Arabia raised oil production despite disruptions to shipments caused by the US-Iran war. That led to a [USN:L6N45Z0RG TEXT:"sharp production increase"] from OPEC+ — the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and partners including Russia — OPEC said on Tuesday. In Russia, the government said on Tuesday it [USN:L1N45Z0B7 TEXT:"did not see"] any direct link between peace talks with Ukraine and its deal to [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"export diesel"] to the US. The comment came after Reuters reported that US envoys had told Ukrainian officials on Friday that the deal was part of an attempt to draw Russia back to negotiations for a [USN:L1N45Y0OS TEXT:"peace settlement"].

item.title: India boat capsizes, drowning 13, mostly children
item.description: A boat capsized in India's eastern state of Bihar, drowning 13 people, most of them children, police said, while six aboard were rescued.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A boat capsized in India's eastern state of Bihar, drowning 13 people, most of them children, police said, while six aboard were rescued. The boat overturned on Tuesday in the state's central district of Vaishali, while carrying passengers to a feast in a neighbouring village, district magistrate Varsha Singh told media. Police are investigating the cause of the incident, regional police officer Subodh Kumar told Reuters on Wednesday, giving the tally of those rescued.

item.title: Dollar languishes as focus turns to CPI, Fed speakers
item.description: The dollar languished on Wednesday as traders awaited fresh signals on the timing for interest rate hikes to contend with persistent inflation.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift
item.content:encoded: The dollar languished on Wednesday as traders awaited fresh signals on the timing for interest rate hikes to contend with persistent inflation. The greenback weakened from an 18-month high in the previous session as oil prices eased and investors reassessed the AI-fueled rally that has supported demand for US assets. The euro clung to gains as budget concerns in France kept regional bond yields elevated and markets on edge. Attention now focuses on the release of US consumer price index data as well as speeches from Federal Reserve policymakers that could clarify the outlook for interest rates. "The risk is the core CPI surprises to the upside because of strong consumer demand and higher costs, pushing up market pricing of an October Fed hike and the USD," Carol Kong, a currency strategist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said in a note. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, edged 0.02% lower to 102.16, following a 0.35% slide on Tuesday. The euro rose 0.04% at $1.1203. The yen was little changed at 158.32 per dollar, and sterling rose 0.03% to $1.3256. The dollar extended losses on Tuesday after New York Fed President John Williams said [USN:FWN45Z0WW TEXT:"he still expects"] one more rate hike this year, but sees no need for further increases in 2027. The US Labor Department is due to release its CPI for September, which is expected to have risen 0.6% month-on-month after increasing 0.4% in August, while annual inflation is seen accelerating to 3.6% from 3.4%. Additionally, the Fed is due to publish its Beige Book. Traders see a 77% chance that the Fed will leave rates unchanged at its October 27-28 meeting, up from 51% a month ago, while pricing in about 75 basis points of tightening by late 2027, CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed. Investors abandoned bets on a Fed rate hike later this month after two policymakers argued for gathering [USN:L6N45N16X TEXT:"more evidence before deciding"] whether further tightening is needed, while Fed Governor Christopher Waller said [USN:L1N45Z0AY TEXT:"inflation expectations remained "well anchored.""] Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat in Virginia, while Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman is set to take part in talks in Bangkok. The International Monetary Fund and World Bank's annual meetings continue in Bangkok, with several appearances expected by European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde on Wednesday. The Australian dollar strengthened 0.06% versus the greenback to $0.6984, while New Zealand's kiwi strengthened 0.09% to $0.5614.
